s3_cn: 供应商只能使用标准或认证材料。

s1_cn: 如果质量通过QA团队审核我们就继续。
s2_en: If the supplier is late, we will use the backup source.
s2_cn: 如果供应商延迟，我们将启用备用供应商。
s3_en: Please notify me if there are any production issues.
s3_cn: 如果有任何生产问题请通知我。

s1_cn: 交货虽迟但质量可接受。
s2_en: Though the test failed, we identified the root cause.
s2_cn: 虽然测试失败，但我们找到了根本原因。
s3_en: The design is complex though it meets all requirements.
s3_cn: 设计虽然复杂但满足所有要求。

s1_cn: 产线运行时不要进入该区域。
s2_en: While the supplier improves quality, we will use the backup source.
s2_cn: 在供应商改进质量期间，我们将使用备用来源。
s3_en: We monitor the process while the machine is operating.
s3_cn: 机器运行时我们监控过程。

s1_en: We discussed how to improve quality at the supplier review.
s1_cn: 在供应商评审中我们讨论了如何提升质量。
s2_en: Can you explain how the new inspection system works?
s2_cn: 你能解释一下新检验系统如何运作吗？
s3_en: Please show the operator how to use the torque wrench.
s3_cn: 请向操作员演示如何使用扭矩扳手。

s1_en: Please wear safety equipment when the line is running.
s1_cn: 产线运行时请佩戴安全装备。
s2_en: When will the new model be ready for mass production?
s2_cn: 新车型什么时候可以量产？
s3_en: Contact the supplier when the inventory drops below 500.
s3_cn: 库存低于500时联系供应商。

s1_en: Please mark where the defect was found on the diagram.
s1_cn: 请在图纸上标出发现缺陷的位置。
s2_en: We need to know where the parts are stored in the warehouse.
s2_cn: 我们需要知道零件在仓库中的存放位置。
s3_en: This is where we assemble the engine module.
s3_cn: 这里是我们装配发动机模块的地方。

s1_en: Do you know why the meeting was canceled?
s1_cn: 你知道会议为什么取消吗？
s2_en: That is why we check the quality twice.
s2_cn: 那就是我们做两次质量检查的原因。
s3_en: Why did the train arrive late today?
s3_cn: 火车今天为什么晚点了？

s1_en: We need to test the parts again after the fix.
s1_cn: 修复后我们需要重新测试零件。
s2_en: Please check the calibration again before starting.
s2_cn: 启动前请再次检查校准。
s3_en: The supplier failed the audit again this year.
s3_cn: 该供应商今年审核又没通过。

s1_en: This is the highest sales ever recorded at this store.
s1_cn: 这是该门店有记录以来的最高销量。
s2_en: Have you ever sold this type of car before?
s2_cn: 你以前卖过这种车吗？
s3_en: The defect rate is the lowest ever achieved.
s3_cn: 缺陷率是史上最低的。

cn: adj. 远的；遥远的；adv. 远；大大地
s1_en: The new model far exceeds the safety standard.
s1_cn: 新车型远超安全标准。
s2_en: Our factory is far from the supplier's warehouse.
s2_cn: 我们工厂离供应商仓库很远。
s3_en: So far, we have sold 50,000 cars this year.
s3_cn: 今年到目前为止我们已售出5万辆车。

s1_en: We can move forward with the supplier approval process.
s1_cn: 我们可以推进供应商审批流程。
s2_en: Please forward the test report to the engineering team.
s2_cn: 请将测试报告转发给工程团队。
s3_en: We look forward to the new model launch next quarter.
s3_cn: 我们期待下季度新车型发布。

s1_en: Here at the store, we sell 30 cars per day.
s1_cn: 在门店这里，我们每天卖出30辆车。
s2_en: Please sign here on the quality inspection form.
s2_cn: 请在质量检验表上此处签字
s3_en: The parts you need are stored here in the warehouse.
s3_cn: 你需要的零件存放在这里的仓库中。

cn: prep. 靠近；接近；adv. 近；附近；adj. 近的；接近的
s1_en: Store the materials near the assembly area for easy access.
s1_cn: 将材料存放在靠近装配区便于取用。
s2_en: Our warehouse is near the manufacturing plant.
s2_cn: 我们的仓库靠近制造工厂。
s3_en: The supplier is located near our main distribution center.
s3_cn: 供应商靠近我们的主要配送中心。

s1_en: The new model is now in mass production.
s1_cn: 新车型正在量产中。
s2_en: We now require all suppliers to use the online portal.
s2_cn: 我们现在要求所有供应商使用在线门户。
s3_en: The quality system is now fully operational.
s3_cn: 质量系统现已全面运行。

s1_en: Please check out the parts before they leave the plant.
s1_cn: 零件出厂前请检查。
s2_en: We found out the root cause of the defect.
s2_cn: 我们查明了缺陷的根本原因。
s3_en: The test was carried out according to the standard.
s3_cn: 测试按标准执行。

s1_en: The design is still under review by the engineering team.
s1_cn: 设计仍在工程团队审核中。
s2_en: The supplier still has not confirmed the delivery date.
s2_cn: 供应商仍未确认交货日期。
s3_en: We are still waiting for the crash test results.
s3_cn: 我们仍在等待碰撞测试结果。

s1_en: First inspect the parts, then test the assembly.
s1_cn: 先检验零件，然后测试装配。
s2_en: The design was approved, then we started production.
s2_cn: 设计批准后我们开始生产。
s3_en: Complete the report, then submit it to the manager.
s3_cn: 完成报告后提交给经理。

s1_en: There is a defect on the surface of the part.
s1_cn: 零件表面存在缺陷。
s2_en: There are 200 vehicles waiting for final inspection.
s2_cn: 有200辆车等待终检。
s3_en: Is there any update from the supplier?
s3_cn: 供应商那边有更新吗？

s1_en: R&D and production must work together on new model launches.
s1_cn: 研发和生产必须在新车型发布上协同工作。
s2_en: Please review the design and the cost estimate together.
s2_cn: 请一起审查设计和成本估算。
s3_en: We bundle the parts together for efficient shipping.
s3_cn: 我们将零件打包在一起以便高效运输。

cn: adj. 健康的；良好的；adv. 好；充分地
s1_en: The new machine performs well in the durability test.
s1_cn: 新机器在耐久性测试中表现良好。
s2_en: The supplier has done well in meeting delivery targets.
s2_cn: 供应商在达成交货目标方面表现不错。
s3_en: We need to plan well to avoid production delays.
s3_cn: 我们需要做好计划以避免生产延误。

s1_en: The store is almost full of customers.
s1_cn: 门店里几乎坐满了客户。
s2_en: We have almost reached our sales target for the month.
s2_cn: 我们几乎完成了本月的销售目标。
s3_en: The test is almost done; results will be ready tomorrow.
s3_cn: 测试即将完成，结果明天出来。

cn: adj. 足够的；adv. 足够地；相当地
s1_en: The material must be strong enough for crash safety.
s1_cn: 材料必须足够坚固以保证碰撞安全。
s2_en: We have enough cars for two weeks of sales.
s2_cn: 我们有足够两周销售用的车辆。
s3_en: Is the data reliable enough for the sourcing decision?
s3_cn: 数据是否足够可靠以做采购决策？

s1_en: The new model's efficiency is even higher than expected.
s1_cn: 新车型的效率甚至高于预期。
s2_en: Even experienced salesmen must follow the script.
s2_cn: 即使经验丰富的销售也必须遵循话术。
s3_en: We test every part, even from our most trusted supplier.
s3_cn: 我们测试每个零件，即使是来自最信任的供应商。

s1_en: The design change is not approved yet.
s1_cn: 设计变更尚未批准。
s2_en: The parts are not ready for assembly.
s2_cn: 零件尚未准备好装配。
s3_en: We can not ship without the quality sign-off.
s3_cn: 没有质量签字我们不能发货。

cn: adj. 唯一的；仅有的；adv. 只；仅仅
s1_en: Use only approved suppliers for critical parts.
s1_cn: 关键零件仅使用批准的供应商。
s2_en: This issue affects only Line 3, not the whole plant.
s2_cn: 此问题仅影响3号线，不影响整个工厂。
s3_en: We have only three days to complete the inspection.
s3_cn: 我们只有三天时间完成检验。

s1_en: The new material is quite different from the previous one.
s1_cn: 新材料与之前的完全不同。
s2_en: The supplier's quality has improved quite a lot.
s2_cn: 供应商的质量有了很大提升。
s3_en: The test result was quite surprising to the team.
s3_cn: 测试结果令团队相当意外。

s1_en: We test every batch so that defects are caught early.
s1_cn: 我们测试每批次以便及早发现缺陷。
s2_en: The defect rate is so low that we passed the audit.
s2_cn: 缺陷率如此之低，我们通过了审核。
s3_en: Please document the process so others can follow.
s3_cn: 请记录流程以便他人遵循。

s1_en: Supplier quality is very important to our production.
s1_cn: 供应商质量对我们的生产非常重要。
s2_en: The surface finish must be very smooth.
s2_cn: 表面处理必须非常光滑。
s3_en: We are very close to meeting the annual target.
s3_cn: 我们非常接近达成年度目标。

s1_en: Please submit the test report by tomorrow.
s1_cn: 请在明天前提交测试报告。
s2_en: The supplier will deliver the samples tomorrow morning.
s2_cn: 供应商明早交付样品。
s3_en: We have a production meeting tomorrow at 9 AM.
s3_cn: 我们明天早上9点开生产会议。

s1_en: Yesterday's production output exceeded the target.
s1_cn: 昨天的产量超过了目标。
s2_en: The supplier sent the quotation yesterday.
s2_cn: 供应商昨天发了报价。
s3_en: We identified the defect during yesterday's inspection.
s3_cn: 我们在昨天的检验中发现了缺陷。

s1_en: Our North America market grew by 15% this year.
s1_cn: 我们北美市场今年增长了15%。
s2_en: The northern plant produces electric vehicle batteries.
s2_cn: 北部工厂生产电动汽车电池。
s3_en: We are expanding our dealer network in the north.
s3_cn: 我们正在北部扩大经销商网络。

s1_en: We plan to enter the Southeast Asian market.
s1_cn: 我们计划进入东南亚市场。
s2_en: The southern plant specializes in SUV production.
s2_cn: 南部工厂专注于SUV生产。
s3_en: Our southern region reported strong sales growth.
s3_cn: 我们南部地区报告了强劲的销售增长。

s1_en: The East Asia market is our largest overseas region.
s1_cn: 东亚市场是我们最大的海外区域。
s2_en: Our eastern region sells parts to all dealers.
s2_cn: 我们东部区域向所有经销商销售零件。
s3_en: We export vehicles to the Middle East and beyond.
s3_cn: 我们向中东及更远地区出口车辆。

s1_en: We are expanding into Western Europe next year.
s1_cn: 我们明年将拓展到西欧市场。
s2_en: Our western distribution center covers three provinces.
s2_cn: 我们西部配送中心覆盖三个省。
s3_en: The supplier is located in the western industrial zone.
s3_cn: 供应商位于西部工业区。

s1_en: Please close the door when you leave.
s1_cn: 离开时请关上门。
s2_en: He said “please” when he asked for help.
s2_cn: 他求助时说了“请”。
s3_en: We should always say “please” and “thank you”.
s3_cn: 我们应该总是说“请”和“谢谢”。

s1_en: Yes, the parts passed the quality inspection.
s1_cn: 是的，零件通过了质量检验。
s2_en: Yes, we can deliver the shipment by Friday.
s2_cn: 是的，我们可以在周五前交货。
s3_en: Yes, the design change was approved.
s3_cn: 是的，设计变更已获批准。

s1_cn: 下新订单前我们需要审核供应商账户。
s2_en: The finance team manages all supplier accounts in the ERP system.
s2_cn: 财务团队在ERP系统中管理所有供应商账户。
s3_en: Please open a new account for the overseas distributor.
s3_cn: 请为海外经销商开立新账户。

cn: n. 行为；法案；v. 行动；扮演
s1_en: The board acted on the audit findings and launched a supplier quality reset.
s1_cn: 董事会根据审计发现采取了行动，启动了供应商质量整顿。
s2_en: Our R&D act of sharing the test plan early cut the validation cycle by three weeks.
s2_cn: 我们研发团队提前共享测试方案的做法，把验证周期缩短了三周。
s3_en: He acted as the project owner and aligned five departments behind one launch date.
s3_cn: 他担任项目负责人的角色，把五个部门对齐到同一个上市节点。

s1_en: In addition, we need more time.
s1_cn: 此外，我们需要更多时间。
s2_en: The addition of sugar changed the taste.
s2_cn: 加了糖改变了味道。
s3_en: Two plus two is a simple addition.
s3_cn: 二加二是简单的加法。

s1_en: We made an adjustment to the plan.
s1_cn: 我们对计划做了调整。
s2_en: The seat needs a small adjustment.
s2_cn: 座椅需要微调。
s3_en: He made a small adjustment to the quote.
s3_cn: 他对报价做了一点调整。

s1_cn: 我看到一款新车的广告。

s2_cn: 广告在广播里。
s3_en: They put up an advertisement online.
s3_cn: 他们在网上登了广告。

s1_en: We signed a three-year service agreement with the dealer.
s1_cn: 我们与经销商签订了三年服务协议。
s2_en: The supply agreement includes quality and delivery terms.
s2_cn: 供应协议包含质量和交货条款。
s3_en: Please review the agreement before the legal team finalizes it.
s3_cn: 法务团队最终确认前请审核协议。

cn: n. 空气；n. 神态；氛围；n. 曲调（复数 airs）；n. 播出（air time）
s1_en: The new flagship showroom gave an air of premium technology to every visitor.
s1_cn: 新的旗舰展厅为每位访客营造出高端科技的氛围。
s2_en: We sealed the paint booth to keep clean air on the line and protect coating quality.
s2_cn: 我们对喷漆房做了密闭，保持产线空气洁净以保障喷涂质量。
s3_en: The launch film earned air time across ten channels in one prime-time window.
s3_cn: 上市宣传片在十个渠道的同一黄金时段获得了播出时段。

s1_en: We received a large amount of export orders this month.
s1_cn: 本月我们收到了大量出口订单。
s2_en: The amount of warranty claims dropped after the fix.
s2_cn: 修复后，保修索赔的数量下降了。
s3_en: Please confirm the exact amount before we issue the invoice.
s3_cn: 开票前请确认准确金额。

s1_en: The annual tech fair proved a useful source of amusement and fresh ideas for the team.
s1_cn: 年度科技展对团队既是消遣，也带来了新点子。
s2_en: A short break for amusement between long meetings can reset focus and lift morale.
s2_cn: 长会之间短暂的娱乐休息能重置注意力、提振士气。
s3_en: The trainer used a light moment of amusement to ease tension before the tough review.
s3_cn: 培训师用轻松的玩笑缓解严苛评审前的紧张。

cn: n. 动物；牲畜；n. 动物皮革（如 Nappa）
s1_en: The premium trim uses Nappa leather from carefully sourced animal hide.
s1_cn: 高端内饰采用精选动物皮革制成的 Nappa 皮。
s2_en: Our lab tests animal-based adhesives for cabin air safety.
s2_cn: 实验室测试动物基胶粘剂的座舱空气安全性。
s3_en: The logistics team planned the transport of live animals under strict welfare rules.
s3_cn: 物流团队按严格福利规范安排活体动物运输。

s1_en: She gave the right answer in the test.
s1_cn: 她在测验中给出了正确答案。
s2_en: Please answer the customer’s email today.
s2_cn: 请今天回复客户的邮件。
s3_en: I called him but there was no answer.
s3_cn: 我打给他，但没人接。

cn: n. 装置；器械；n. 机构（常用单数）
s1_en: The lab calibrated the testing apparatus before every crash-sensor validation run.
s1_cn: 实验室在每次碰撞传感器验证前都先校准测试装置。
s2_en: Our quality apparatus spans incoming inspection, in-line gauging, and final audit.
s2_cn: 我们的质量体系涵盖来料检验、在线测量与终检审核。
s3_en: Engineers installed a new measurement apparatus to trace weld strength in real time.
s3_cn: 工程师安装了新的测量装置，以实时追踪焊接强度。

s1_en: We need engineering approval before changing the material specification.
s1_cn: 更改材料规格前需要工程批准。
s2_en: The design approval process takes about two weeks.
s2_cn: 设计批准流程大约需要两周。
s3_en: All cost changes require manager approval.
s3_cn: 所有成本变更都需要经理批准。

cn: n. 论点；论据；n. 争论
s1_en: She made a strong argument for moving the EV platform to an 800V architecture.
s1_cn: 她为把电动车平台转向 800V 架构提出了有力的论据。
s2_en: The business case won because its argument rested on three years of field data.
s2_cn: 该商业方案胜出，因为它的论点建立在三年的现场数据之上。

s3_cn: 我们用一次快速的 A/B 样件解决了设计分歧，而不是开长会。

cn: n. 艺术；n. 技艺；诀窍
s1_en: Plant management is the art of balancing output, cost, and people every single day.
s1_cn: 工厂管理是一门每天都要在产量、成本与人之间取得平衡的诀窍。
s2_en: The stamping team mastered the art of defect-free panels through disciplined SPC.
s2_cn: 冲压团队通过严谨的统计过程控制，掌握了零缺陷钣金的诀窍。
s3_en: Good negotiation is an art that our procurement leads use to lock in stable prices.
s3_cn: 好的谈判是一门艺术，我们的采购负责人借此锁定稳定价格。

cn: v. 攻克；着手处理；n. （市场/竞争）攻势
s1_en: The cost office attacked the overhead problem with a zero-based budgeting reset.
s1_cn: 成本部门以零基预算重整着手攻克管理费用过高的问题。
s2_en: Our new SUV attacked the premium segment with class-leading active safety.
s2_cn: 我们的新款 SUV 以同级领先的主动安全向高端细分市场发起攻势。
s3_en: She attacked the launch delay by re-sequencing the build and pulling in extra shifts.
s3_cn: 她通过重排生产顺序并增加班次，着手解决了上市延迟。

cn: v. 试图；尝试；n. 尝试
s1_en: We attempted to cut door-assembly time by integrating the wiring harness upstream.
s1_cn: 我们试图通过把线束工序前移，来压缩门线装配时间。
s2_en: The first attempt at lights-out machining failed, so we retuned the fixtures.
s2_cn: 首次无人化加工的尝试失败了，于是我们重新调整了夹具。
s3_en: His attempt to standardize the report saved the team four hours each week.
s3_cn: 他标准化报表的尝试，每周为团队节省四小时。

cn: n. 注意；关注；n. 照料

s1_cn: 副总裁密切关注保修理化趋势，并为此组建了根因攻关团队。

s1_en: The service contract covers the cost of both routine and unexpected repairs.
s1_cn: 服务合同涵盖了常规与突发维修的成本。
s2_en: Our training plan covers every station from stamping to final inspection.
s2_cn: 我们的培训计划覆盖从冲压到终检的每一个工位。
s3_en: The report's cover featured the new model, signaling the brand's tech turn.
s3_cn: 报告的封面是新车型，传递出品牌转向科技的信号。

cn: n. 裂缝；裂纹；v. 开裂；破解
s1_en: The crack is critical for vehicle safety.
s1_cn: 裂缝对车辆安全至关重要。
s2_en: The crack was validated through a pilot run.
s2_cn: 裂缝通过试生产验证。
s3_en: We need to review the crack for this project.
s3_cn: 我们需要审查这个项目的裂缝。

s1_en: The bank gave him credit to buy a car.
s1_cn: 银行给他贷款买车。
s2_en: She has good credit with the shop.
s2_cn: 她在店里信用良好。
s3_en: Please check your credit before you borrow.
s3_cn: 借款前请先查一下你的信用。

s1_en: Preventing financial crime is written into every supplier code of conduct.
s1_cn: 防范金融犯罪被写进了每一份供应商行为准则。
s2_en: The audit found no sign of crime, only a control gap we closed within a week.
s2_cn: 审计未发现犯罪迹象，只有一个我们在周内补齐的控制漏洞。
s3_en: Training on crime risk helped buyers spot a fake-invoice attempt in time.
s3_cn: 关于犯罪风险的培训，帮助采购及时识破了一起虚假发票企图。

cn: v. 压碎；压坏；v. 击溃；大胜；n. 拥挤人群
s1_en: The sales region crushed its quarterly target by delivering 118 percent of plan.
s1_cn: 该销售大区以达成计划的 118% 大幅超额完成季度目标。
s2_en: The press crushes the blank at 800 tonnes to form the door inner in one stroke.
s2_cn: 压机以 800 吨力将板坯一次压制成门内板。
s3_en: We crushed the launch delay by pulling forward two engineering milestones.
s3_cn: 我们通过把两个工程里程碑提前，一举消除了上市延迟。

s1_en: The falling sales were a cry for help from the market.
s1_cn: 销量下滑是市场发出的求援信号。
s2_en: Suppliers cried foul over the sudden order cut.
s2_cn: 供应商对突如其来的砍单喊冤。
s3_en: He cried out when the ramp safety sensor tripped.
s3_cn: 当坡道安全传感器触发时，他大声警示。

cn: adj. 当前的；流通的；n. 电流；水流
s1_en: We check the current market trend before we set the price.
s1_cn: 定价前我们查看当前市场趋势。
s2_en: The current data is tracked in the quality system.
s2_cn: 当前数据在质量系统中跟踪。
s3_en: All parts must meet the current standard.
s3_cn: 所有零件必须达到当前标准。

s1_en: The road has a gentle curve.
s1_cn: 这条路有个平缓的弯道。
s2_en: Draw a curve on the paper.
s2_cn: 在纸上画一条曲线。
s3_en: The curve of the fender looks smooth.
s3_cn: 翼子板的曲线看起来流畅。

cn: n. 损害；损坏；损害赔偿；v. 损害；损坏
s1_en: The damage claim is filed after the delivery defect.
s1_cn: 交付缺陷发生后，提出了损害赔偿索赔。
s2_en: A single recall can damage the brand for years.
s2_cn: 一次召回能在多年里损害品牌。
s3_en: We set a damage threshold for each critical safety part.
s3_cn: 我们为每个关键安全件设定了损伤阈值。

s1_en: The line was in danger of missing the audit, so we ran a focused two-day blitz.
s1_cn: 产线面临通不过审核的风险，于是我们开展了一次为期两天的集中攻坚。
s2_en: High-voltage training keeps technicians out of danger during pack repairs.
s2_cn: 高压培训使技师在电池包维修时远离危险。
s3_en: We flagged the danger early and stopped the run before a single bad part shipped.
s3_cn: 我们及早标出了危险，在任何一个不良件流出前就停了线。

s1_en: The daughter company handles overseas distribution.
s1_cn: 子公司负责海外分销。
s2_en: We spun off the unit as a wholly-owned daughter company.
s2_cn: 我们将该业务分拆为全资控股子公司。
s3_en: The daughter company posted record profit this year.
s3_cn: 子公司今年创下利润纪录。

cn: n. 天；白天；n. 工作日
s1_en: Day by day, the pilot line improved its first-pass yield from 82 to 96 percent.
s1_cn: 试点产线日复一日地把一次合格率从 82% 提升到 96%。
s2_en: On launch day, the cross-functional war room cleared issues within the hour.
s2_cn: 上市当天，跨职能作战室在一小时内清掉了问题。
s3_en: He blocked one focus day each week so deep design work is never crowded out.
s3_cn: 他每周留出一天专注日，使深度的设计工作不被挤占。

cn: n. 死亡；n. 终结；失效
s1_en: Active cooling prevented the thermal death of the battery pack in the heat test.
s1_cn: 主动冷却在耐热测试中防止了电池包的过热失效。
s2_en: The phased plan managed the death of the old platform without a line stop.
s2_cn: 分阶段方案在不停线的情况下，平稳完成了旧平台的退役。
s3_en: We treated silent defects as the death of trust, so we built in-line checks everywhere.
s3_cn: 我们把隐性缺陷视为信任的终结，因此在每个环节都加了在线检查。

s1_en: The joint venture kept net debt below the covenant ceiling through tight cash control.
s1_cn: 合资公司通过严格的现金管控，将净负债保持在契约上限之下。
s2_en: We paid down the equipment debt a year early and freed budget for R&D.
s2_cn: 我们提前一年还清了设备欠款，为研发腾出了预算。
s3_en: A clear debt schedule helped the plant win board backing for the expansion.
s3_cn: 清晰的偿债计划帮助工厂赢得了董事会对扩产的支持。

s1_en: The sourcing decision will affect our cost structure for years.
s1_cn: 采购决策将影响我们多年的成本结构。
s2_en: We need data to support the design decision.
s2_cn: 我们需要数据来支持设计决策。
s3_en: The committee postponed the decision pending further tests.
s3_cn: 委员会推迟了决定，待进一步测试。

s1_en: The water reached a high degree of heat.
s1_cn: 水达到了很高的温度。
s2_en: He got a degree in engineering.
s2_cn: 他拿到了工程学位。
s3_en: To a degree, the plan worked.
s3_cn: 在某种程度上，计划奏效了。

cn: n. 设计；图案；v. 设计；构思
s1_en: The design specification must meet both safety and cost targets.
s1_cn: 设计规格必须同时满足安全和成本目标。
s2_en: Our design team uses CAD software for 3D modeling.
s2_cn: 我们的设计团队使用CAD软件进行三维建模。
s3_en: The supplier submitted a new design proposal for the bracket.
s3_cn: 供应商提交了支架的新设计方案。

s1_en: Customer desire for connected features drives our product roadmap.
s1_cn: 客户对互联功能的需求推动了我们的产品路线图。
s2_en: We analyze market desire data to prioritize feature development.
s2_cn: 我们分析市场需求数据以优先功能开发。
s3_en: Understanding customer desire is key to successful product launch.
s3_cn: 理解客户需求是成功产品上市的关键。

cn: n. 破坏；毁灭；n. （可控）损毁测试
s1_en: The crash lab used controlled destruction to prove the cabin protects occupants.
s1_cn: 碰撞实验室用可控损毁测试，证明座舱能保护乘员。
s2_en: We learned more from the destruction of the prototype than from a hundred slides.
s2_cn: 我们从原型车的损毁中学到的，比看一百页幻灯片都多。
s3_en: Fire training taught the team to stop destruction before it spreads on the line.
s3_cn: 消防培训教会团队在火势于产线蔓延前就将其控制。

s1_en: Please review every design detail before releasing the drawings.
s1_cn: 发布图纸前请审核每个设计细节。
s2_en: The technical detail is explained in the engineering manual.
s2_cn: 技术细节在工程手册中有说明。
s3_en: We need more detail on the supplier's quality process.
s3_cn: 我们需要更多关于供应商质量流程的细节。

s1_en: The new product development cycle takes about 36 months.
s1_cn: 新产品开发周期大约需要36个月。
s2_en: Our R&D development team is working on the next-gen platform.
s2_cn: 我们的研发团队正在开发下一代平台。
s3_en: The development budget was approved by the board.
s3_cn: 开发预算已获董事会批准。

cn: n. 消化（生理）；n. 理解；吸收（信息）
s1_en: After digestion of the field report, the team changed the suspension tune.
s1_cn: 在吃透现场报告之后，团队调整了悬架调校。
s2_en: Slow digestion of complex specs caused the delay, so we added a walk-through.
s2_cn: 对复杂规范的缓慢理解导致了延误，于是我们增加了一次走查讲解。
s3_en: A short debrief aids digestion of the test data far better than a long email.
s3_cn: 一次简短的复盘，比一封长邮件更有助于吃透测试数据。

s1_en: The car turned in the right direction.
s1_cn: 车朝正确的方向转弯。
s2_en: He gave me the direction to the station.
s2_cn: 他告诉我去车站的方向。
s3_en: Sales are moving in a good direction.
s3_cn: 销售正朝好的方向发展。

cn: n. 发现；n. 被发现的事物
s1_en: A teardown made the key discovery that the weld had a hidden cold spot.
s1_cn: 一次拆解让我们取得关键发现：该焊缝存在隐蔽的冷点。
s2_en: The data team made the discovery that warranty claims fell after the retrain.
s2_cn: 数据团队发现，重新培训后索赔量下降了。
s3_en: Each discovery in the teardown goes straight into the next generation's spec.
s3_cn: 拆解中每一个发现都直接进入了下一代产品的规格。

s1_en: Technical discussions with the supplier are documented in the meeting minutes.
s1_cn: 与供应商的技术讨论记录在会议纪要中。
s2_en: We hold a cross functional discussion before any design change.
s2_cn: 任何设计变更前我们召开跨部门讨论。
s3_en: The discussion outcome is tracked in the engineering change log.
s3_cn: 讨论结果在工程变更日志中跟踪。

s1_en: The plant hygiene program prevented disease spread in the shared canteen.
s1_cn: 工厂卫生方案防止了疾病在公共食堂传播。
s2_en: We screened for disease risk in the supply of natural-rubber parts.
s2_cn: 我们对天然橡胶件的供应做了疾病风险筛查。
s3_en: Early prevention of disease kept attendance high through the peak season.
s3_cn: 疾病的早期预防，使出勤率在旺季保持高位。

cn: n. 厌恶；反感；v. 使反感
s1_en: To the team's disgust, a simple loose bolt caused the whole recall.
s1_cn: 令团队反感的是，一个小小的松动螺栓竟引发了整批召回。
s2_en: Customer disgust with late deliveries pushed us to rebuild the logistics SLA.
s2_cn: 客户对延迟交付的反感，推动我们重建了物流服务水平协议。
s3_en: We removed the disgust-causing defect by sealing the process at the source.
s3_cn: 我们从源头封住工序，消除了引发反感的那处缺陷。

cn: n. 距离；n. 远方；v. 拉开距离
phrase_cn: 保持距离；保持领先距离
s1_en: The brand kept its distance from rivals by leading on smart-cabin software.
s1_cn: 该品牌凭智能座舱软件领先，与竞争对手拉开了距离。
s2_en: We cut the transport distance by moving the seat line next to final assembly.
s2_cn: 我们把座椅线移到总装旁，从而缩短了运输距离。
s3_en: At a distance, the new facade reads as premium, which helps the showroom draw.
s3_cn: 从远处看，新立面显得高端，有助于展厅引流。

cn: n. 分销；配送；n. 分布
s1_en: The new distribution network cut regional delivery time from nine to four days.
s1_cn: 新的分销网络把区域交付时间从九天缩短到四天。
s2_en: Demand distribution showed the SUV skewed young, so we tuned the campaign.
s2_cn: 需求分布显示该 SUV 偏年轻群体，于是我们调整了营销。
s3_en: We split distribution by region to keep each warehouse under 80 percent load.
s3_cn: 我们按区域拆分配送，使每个仓库的负荷都低于 80%。

s1_en: The division of the work was fair.
s1_cn: 工作的划分很公平。
s2_en: Ten divided by two is a simple division.
s2_cn: 十除以二是简单的除法。
s3_en: The division of the land took a year.
s3_cn: 土地的划分花了一年。

s1_en: Any quality doubt must be escalated to the quality manager immediately.
s1_cn: 任何质量疑虑都须立即上报质量经理
s2_en: We clear all doubt about the car before the sale.
s2_cn: 我们在售车前消除对车辆的所有疑虑
s3_en: When in doubt, stop the line is our default quality principle.
s3_cn: 有疑虑时，停线是我们默认的质量原则

s1_en: The two CEOs drank to the closing of the joint venture.
s1_cn: 两位CEO为合资企业的达成干杯。
s2_en: We should not drink the Kool-Aid on every new trend.
s2_cn: 我们不该对每一个新趋势都盲目跟风。
s3_en: The team drank in the feedback from the pilot launch.
s3_cn: 团队认真吸纳了试点发布中的反馈。

s1_en: The driving cycle test validates fuel consumption and emissions.
s1_cn: 驾驶循环测试验证油耗和排放。
s2_en: We simulate real world driving conditions in the test cell.
s2_cn: 我们在测试间模拟真实驾驶条件。
s3_en: Driving dynamics are tuned on the proving ground track.
s3_cn: 驾驶动态在试车场上调校。

cn: n. 灰尘；粉尘；v. 拭去灰尘
s1_en: We dusted off a stalled project and shipped it as a low-cost variant.
s1_cn: 我们重新启用了搁置的项目，把它做成了一款低成本变体。
s2_en: The paint shop filters dust so the clear coat stays free of specks.
s2_cn: 喷漆房过滤粉尘，使清漆层不出现颗粒。
s3_en: Metal dust from grinding is captured at source to protect worker lungs.
s3_cn: 打磨产生的金属粉尘在源头被收集，以保护工人肺部。

cn: n. 地球；泥土；adv. 究竟（用于强调，on earth）
s1_en: What on earth caused the line to stop?
s1_cn: 到底是什么原因导致产线停了？
s2_en: We must protect the earth's environment in every plant.
s2_cn: 我们必须保护地球的生态环境，落实到每一座工厂。
s3_en: The new plant sits on reclaimed earth near the port.
s3_cn: 新工厂建在港口附近一块复垦的土地上。

cn: n. 边缘；n. 优势；竞争力；v. 缓慢移动；微弱领先
s1_en: Local R&D gave us a competitive edge in cold-weather range tuning.
s1_cn: 本地研发让我们在低温续航调校上获得竞争优势。
s2_en: The robot edged the panel into place within a half-millimeter tolerance.
s2_cn: 机器人将板材以半毫米公差缓缓就位。
s3_en: We kept our edge by refreshing the model every eighteen months, not thirty-six.
s3_cn: 我们每十八个月而非三十六个月焕新车型，从而保住优势。

cn: n. 教育；n. 培训；培养
s1_en: On-the-job education lifted new-hire output to standard in just three weeks.
s1_cn: 在岗培训让新员工仅三周就达到标准产出。
s2_en: The supplier education program cut incoming defects by a third in one quarter.
s2_cn: 供应商培养计划在一个季度内把来料缺陷降低三分之一。
s3_en: Continuous education is how the tech workforce keeps pace with EV change.
s3_cn: 持续培养是技术队伍跟上电动车变革节奏的方式。

cn: n. 效果；影响；v. 实现；使生效
s1_en: We put the new change-control into effect and defects from rushed fixes dropped.
s1_cn: 我们把新的变更控制付诸实施，草率修改导致的缺陷随之下降。
s2_en: The price effect of the new trim level showed up in the mix within a month.
s2_cn: 新配置级别的价格影响在一个月内就体现在产品组合上。
s3_en: She effected the turnaround by renegotiating the top three supplier contracts.
s3_cn: 她通过重新谈判前三家供应商合同，实现了扭亏为盈。

s1_en: The road is at the end of the street.
s1_cn: 路在街的尽头。
s2_en: We reached the end of the project.
s2_cn: 我们完成了这个项目。
s3_en: Please read to the end of the page.
s3_cn: 请读到这一页的末尾。

s1_en: We traced the sales error to a data issue.
s1_cn: 我们追溯到数据问题导致的销售错误。
s2_en: Please report any system error to the IT department immediately.
s2_cn: 请立即向IT部门报告任何系统错误。
s3_en: Human error caused the lost deal yesterday.
s3_cn: 人为错误导致昨天丢了一单。

s1_en: The event was a great success.
s1_cn: 这次活动非常成功。
s2_en: We planned the event for next month.
s2_cn: 我们把活动定在下个月。
s3_en: A strange event happened last night.
s3_cn: 昨晚发生了一件怪事。

s1_en: For example, cars need regular care.
s1_cn: 例如，汽车需要定期保养。
s2_en: This is a good example to follow.
s2_cn: 这是个值得效仿的好例子。
s3_en: Can you give me an example?
s3_cn: 你能给我举个例子吗？

cn: n. 交换；交流；兑换；v. 交换；兑换
s1_en: He gave me a book in exchange for a pen.
s1_cn: 他给我一本书换一支笔。
s2_en: We had an exchange of ideas.
s2_cn: 我们交流了想法。
s3_en: The exchange of gifts is a custom.
s3_cn: 互赠礼物是一种习俗。

s1_en: The supplier has been in existence for over twenty years.
s1_cn: 这家供应商已经营存续超过二十年。
s2_en: We doubt the existence of that overdue file.
s2_cn: 我们怀疑那份逾期文件是否真实存在。
s3_en: The joint venture's existence depends on the new contract.
s3_cn: 这家合资企业的存续取决于那份新合同。

s1_en: The expansion of the dealer network took two years.
s1_cn: 经销商网络的扩张耗时两年。
s2_en: A phased expansion lets us test demand before full commitment.
s2_cn: 分阶段扩张能让我们在全面投入前先验证需求。
s3_en: The company plans an overseas expansion next year.
s3_cn: 公司计划明年进行海外扩张。

s1_en: Our salesman has over 15 years of sales experience.
s1_cn: 我们的销售员有超过15年的销售经验。
s2_en: The engineer's experience in crash testing is invaluable.
s2_cn: 工程师在碰撞测试方面的经验非常宝贵。
s3_en: We value overseas market experience when selecting dealers.
s3_cn: 选择经销商时我们看重海外市场经验。

s1_en: We invited a technical expert to review the battery design.
s1_cn: 我们邀请了一位技术专家来审查电池设计。
s2_en: Our quality experts will audit the supplier next week.
s2_cn: 我们的质量专家下周将审核供应商。
s3_en: The expert confirmed that the material meets the standard.
s3_cn: 专家确认材料符合标准。

s1_en: In fact, the line beat plan by 12 percent once we removed the changeover loss.
s1_cn: 事实上，在我们消除换型损失后，产线超额完成计划 12%。
s2_en: The fact that warranty fell told us the design fix had worked.
s2_cn: 索赔量下降这一事实告诉我们，设计整改生效了。
s3_en: We decide on facts from the MES, not on opinion from the last meeting.
s3_cn: 我们依据制造执行系统的数据做决定，而非上次会议的片面看法。

s1_en: The exclusivity deal fell through at the last minute.
s1_cn: 这份独家协议在最后一刻告吹了。
s2_en: All units fell in line with the new pricing policy.
s2_cn: 所有业务单元都遵从了新定价政策。

s1_en: Please move the box to the corner.

cn: n. 名字；品牌；v. 命名；点名

s3_cn: 审计点名了三位责任人，各自在周五前关闭了发现项。

s3_cn: 该国向电动车的转型，为我们的培训项目打开了新渠道。

cn: n. 需要；需求；v. 需要

s1_cn: 好消息是缺陷率提前两周降到了目标以下。
s2_en: The sales team shared the news of a thousand-unit order at the stand-up.

s1_cn: 发动机发出奇怪的噪音。

s3_en: A loud noise means a problem.
s3_cn: 很大的噪音意味着有问题。

cn: n. 笔记；便条；v. 注意；指出

s3_cn: 重排产线排程前，请注意节拍已变更。

cn: n. 数字；数量；n. 号码

s1_cn: 若干供应商没赶上节点，于是我们建了第二货源。
s2_en: The part number on the drawing must match the one on the physical label.
s2_cn: 图纸上的零件号必须与实物标签上的完全一致。
s3_en: We track the number of warranty claims as a live health score.
s3_cn: 我们把保修索赔数量当作实时的健康度指标来追踪。

cn: n. 观察；n. 评论；意见
s1_en: On the observation that scrap rose after breaks, we added a warm-up routine.

s3_cn: 请始终遵循标准作业程序。
