s1_cn: 我们改进了制造工艺以缩短周期时间。
s2_en: Each process step must be documented in the SOP.
s2_cn: 每个工艺步骤必须记录在标准作业指导书中。
s3_en: The new process was validated through a pilot run.
s3_cn: 新工艺通过试生产验证。

s1_en: The supplier can produce 10,000 components per day.
s1_cn: 供应商每天能生产一万个零件。
s2_en: We produce both gasoline and electric vehicles on the same line.
s2_cn: 我们在同一条线上生产燃油车和电动车。
s3_en: The plant will produce the new model starting next month.
s3_cn: 工厂将从下月开始生产新车型。

s1_en: The profit margin on overseas sales is higher than domestic.
s1_cn: 海外销售的利润率高于国内。
s2_en: We need to reduce costs to maintain our profit target.
s2_cn: 我们需要降低成本以维持利润目标。
s3_en: The supplier's profit was affected by raw material prices.
s3_cn: 供应商利润受到原材料价格影响。

cn: n. 财产；资产；n. 性质；特性；n. 房地产
s1_en: The material property of the new alloy let us drop one weld step.
s1_cn: 新合金的材料特性，让我们省掉了一道焊接工序。
s2_en: The firm bought the adjacent property to expand the test track.
s2_cn: 公司买下相邻地块，以扩建试车场。
s3_en: Intellectual property from the lab became three licensed supplier processes.
s3_cn: 实验室的知识产权转化成了三项授权给供应商的工艺。

s1_en: Write the risk note in plain prose, not jargon.
s1_cn: 风险说明用平实文字写，别用行话。
s2_en: The executive summary distills the data into clear prose.
s2_cn: 高管摘要把数据提炼成清晰的文字。
s3_en: Good prose makes the proposal easier to approve.
s3_cn: 好的文字表达让方案更容易获批。

cn: n. 抗议；反对；v. 抗议；申辩
s1_en: A supplier protest against a rejection is handled through the formal appeal process.
s1_cn: 供应商对拒收的异议通过正式申诉流程处理。
s2_en: We document any protest from the customer in the complaint log.
s2_cn: 我们将客户的任何异议记录在投诉日志中。
s3_en: The protest resolution must be completed within 5 business days.
s3_cn: 异议解决必须在5个工作日内完成。

s1_en: We pulled together a cross-functional team to fix the launch slip in a week.
s1_cn: 我们齐心协力组建跨职能团队，一周内解决了上市延迟。
s2_en: The ad pulled a record number of test-drive bookings in three days.
s2_cn: 这则广告三天内吸引了创纪录的试驾预约量。
s3_en: The robot's pull holds the panel steady during the final bolt pass.
s3_cn: 机器人的拉力在最后一道拧紧时稳稳扶住板材。

cn: n. 惩罚；n. 严苛考验（口语）
s1_en: The chassis took a punishment on the rough test loop and still passed.
s1_cn: 底盘在粗糙的测试环路上经受了严苛考验，依然通过。
s2_en: The durability rig puts the seat through a punishment no owner will ever see.
s2_cn: 耐久台架让座椅经受车主永远碰不到的严苛考验。
s3_en: Fair punishment for a missed milestone is a reset plan, not a blame game.
s3_cn: 对错过节点的公正处置，是重定计划，而非互相指责。

s1_en: The purpose of the meeting is clear.
s1_cn: 会议的目的很明确。
s2_en: He came for the purpose of study.
s2_cn: 他为了学习而来。
s3_en: What is the purpose of this tool?
s3_cn: 这个工具是用来做什么的？

s1_en: Push the green button to start.
s1_cn: 按绿色按钮启动。
s2_en: He pushed the cart to the warehouse.
s2_cn: 他把推车推到了仓库。
s3_en: Do not push the door; pull it.
s3_cn: 别推门，拉它。

s1_en: Our quality control standard exceeds the industry requirement.
s1_cn: 我们的质量控制标准超出行业要求。
s2_en: The supplier must meet our quality standard for every shipment.
s2_cn: 供应商每批发货都必须达到我们的质量标准。
s3_en: Quality issues must be reported within 24 hours.
s3_cn: 质量问题必须在24小时内报告。

cn: n. 问题；疑问；v. 质疑；询问
s1_en: A zero-defect launch is out of the question without in-line checks.
s1_cn: 没有在线检查，零缺陷上市是不可能的。
s2_en: The dealer asked a sharp question that reshaped the service plan.
s2_cn: 经销商提了一个尖锐的问题，使服务方案重新调整。
s3_en: We questioned the spec and found a test that added no value.
s3_cn: 我们质疑了那份规范，发现其中有一项测试毫无价值。

s1_en: The test fleet ran rain or shine to prove the seals before the monsoon.
s1_cn: 测试车队风雨无阻地跑，以在雨季前验证密封性。
s2_en: Heavy rain on the launch day still drew a full crowd to the outdoor event.
s2_cn: 上市当天下大雨，户外活动依然吸引了满场人群。
s3_en: We sealed the connector so rain never reaches the high-voltage circuit.
s3_cn: 我们把接插件密封好，使雨水永远接触不到高压电路。

s1_en: The shop has a wide range of cars.
s1_cn: 这家店有广泛的车型范围。
s2_en: The price ranges from 50 to 100.
s2_cn: 价格在50到100之间。
s3_en: He has a range of skills.
s3_cn: 他具备多种技能。

cn: n. 比率；速率；v. 评估；评级
s1_en: The first-pass rate rose to 96 percent after we fixed the fixture.
s1_cn: 一次合格率在修好夹具后升到了 96%。
s2_en: We rate suppliers on quality, cost, and delivery, not on relationship alone.
s2_cn: 我们从质量、成本、交付三方面评估供应商，而非只看关系。
s3_en: The line runs at a rate of sixty units an hour on the current takt.
s3_cn: 按当前节拍，产线以每小时六十台的速度运行。

s1_en: A ray of light came through the window.
s1_cn: 一道光线从窗户射入。
s2_en: The sun’s rays warmed the car seat.
s2_cn: 太阳的光线温暖了座椅。
s3_en: X-rays are used to check welds.
s3_cn: X射线用于检查焊缝。

s1_en: A late part set off a chain reaction that slipped the whole launch by a week.
s1_cn: 一个迟到的零件引发了连锁反应，使整个上市推迟了一周。
s2_en: The market's reaction to the price cut was a sharp lift in orders.
s2_cn: 市场对降价的反应是订单大幅上升。
s3_en: We studied the chemical reaction in the cell to extend battery life.
s3_cn: 我们研究了电芯内的化学反应，以延长电池寿命。

cn: n. 阅读；n. 读数；解读
s1_en: The sensor takes a reading every second and feeds the quality model.
s1_cn: 传感器每秒读取一次数据，喂给质量模型。
s2_en: Her reading of the warranty data showed the fault was in the harness.
s2_cn: 她对保修数据的解读显示，故障出在线束。
s3_en: Daily reading of the line dashboard keeps managers ahead of issues.
s3_cn: 每天看产线看板，让管理者走在问题前面。

s1_en: What is the reason for the late delivery?
s1_cn: 交货延迟的原因是什么？
s2_en: For this reason, we changed the supplier.
s2_cn: 出于这个原因，我们更换了供应商。
s3_en: He gave a clear reason for his decision.
s3_cn: 他为自己的决定给出了清楚的理由。

cn: n. 记录；档案；v. 记录；录制
s1_en: Please keep all quality records for at least five years.
s1_cn: 请保留所有质量记录至少五年。
s2_en: The production record shows a 10% increase in output.
s2_cn: 生产记录显示产量增长了10%。
s3_en: We found a discrepancy in the inspection records.
s3_cn: 我们在检验记录中发现了一处不一致。

cn: n. 遗憾；v. 遗憾；懊悔
s1_en: We regret to inform dealers of the one-week slip, but the fix is worth it.
s1_cn: 我们遗憾地通知经销商延期一周，但这次整改值得。
s2_en: His only regret was not building the second source a year earlier.
s2_cn: 他唯一的遗憾是没早一年建好第二货源。
s3_en: A clean close-out leaves no regret at the end of a hard launch.
s3_cn: 干净的收尾，让一场艰难上市结束时毫无遗憾。

s1_en: There is a close relation between sleep and health.
s1_cn: 睡眠与健康关系密切。
s2_en: He is a relation of mine.
s2_cn: 他是我的一个亲戚。
s3_en: We should keep a good relation with our clients.
s3_cn: 我们应与客户保持良好关系。

cn: n. 宗教；n. 信仰；信条
s1_en: Safety is the religion of this plant, observed in every single step.
s1_cn: 安全是这家工厂的信条，体现在每一个步骤里。
s2_en: The team treats on-time delivery as a religion, not a target.
s2_cn: 团队把准时交付当作信条，而非单纯指标。
s3_en: We respect every religion in the workforce and plan shifts around them.
s3_cn: 我们尊重员工的各种信仰，并据此安排班次。

s1_en: Our dealers represent the brand image in each local market.
s1_cn: 我们的经销商在每个本地市场代表品牌形象。
s2_en: The test results represent the actual performance under real conditions.
s2_cn: 测试结果代表真实条件下的实际性能。
s3_en: We ensure the export model represents our latest technology standard.
s3_cn: 我们确保出口车型代表我们的最新技术标准。

cn: n. 请求；要求；v. 请求；要求
s1_en: The dealer's request for a faster quote led to our new configurator.
s1_cn: 经销商对更快报价的要求，催生了我们的新配置器。
s2_en: We requested a second sample before approving the tooling.
s2_cn: 在批准模具前，我们要求再送一件样品。
s3_en: The request for proposal went to five suppliers, and three qualified.
s3_cn: 招标书发给了五家供应商，其中三家合格。

cn: n. 尊重；v. 尊重；遵守
s1_en: With respect to cost, the lighter bracket beat the original by fifteen percent.
s1_cn: 就成本而言，更轻的支架比原方案低了 15%。
s2_en: We respect the lead time and never push a change inside the freeze window.
s2_cn: 我们遵守前置期，从不在冻结窗口内强推变更。
s3_en: The team earned respect by hitting every milestone for a year straight.
s3_cn: 团队靠连续一年达成每个节点，赢得了尊重。

cn: n. 剩余（部分）；休息；v. 休息；休止
s1_en: Let us have a rest after lunch.
s1_cn: 午饭后我们休息一下吧。
s2_en: The doctor told him to rest.
s2_cn: 医生让他休息。
s3_en: The rest of the team finished the work.
s3_cn: 其余的队员完成了工作。

s1_en: He got a reward for good work.
s1_cn: 他因工作出色获得了奖励。
s2_en: The reward was a free trip.
s2_cn: 奖励是一次免费旅行。
s3_en: Honest work brings its own reward.
s3_cn: 踏实工作自有回报。

s1_en: The new shift pattern found a work rhythm that lifted output by eight percent.
s1_cn: 新的排班找到了一种工作节奏，使产出提升 8%。
s2_en: The line's rhythm broke when a sensor failed, so we added a backup.
s2_cn: 传感器故障打断了产线的节奏，于是我们加了备份。
s3_en: A steady rhythm of small launches beats one giant, risky bet.
s3_cn: 稳定节奏的小步上市，胜过一次巨大的冒险。

s1_en: The rice harvester uses our diesel engine.
s1_cn: 这台水稻收割机使用我们的柴油发动机。
s2_en: We export rice harvesters to Southeast Asia.
s2_cn: 我们向东南亚出口水稻收割机。
s3_en: A late order for rice planters caught the line off guard.
s3_cn: 水稻插秧机的紧急订单让产线措手不及。

s1_en: The successful model generated a river of cash for the group.
s1_cn: 这款成功车型为集团带来了现金洪流。
s2_en: Never sell your team down the river for a short-term bonus.
s2_cn: 绝不要为了短期奖金而出卖自己的团队。
s3_en: We must cross the river of regulation before entering the market.
s3_cn: 进入市场前，我们必须渡过监管这条河。

s1_en: The road to the plant is under repair.
s1_cn: 通往工厂的路正在维修。
s2_en: Be careful when you cross the road.
s2_cn: 过马路时要小心。
s3_en: We drove along a long country road.
s3_cn: 我们沿着一条长长的乡间公路行驶。

cn: v. 滚动；推进；n. 名单；花名册
s1_en: We rolled out the new line across three plants in one quarter.
s1_cn: 我们在一个季度内把新产线推广到了三家工厂。
s2_en: The roll of certified inspectors grew to cover every shift.
s2_cn: 持证检验员的名单扩大到覆盖每个班次。
s3_en: The steel coil rolls into the press and exits as a shaped door panel.
s3_cn: 钢卷滚入压机，出来时已成形的门板。

s1_en: The audit found room for improvement in the procurement process.
s1_cn: 审计发现采购流程还有改进空间。
s2_en: We made room in the budget for the training program.
s2_cn: 我们在预算中为培训项目腾出了空间。
s3_en: There is little room for error in a safety-critical launch.
s3_cn: 在安全至上的发布中，几乎没有出错的空间。

s1_en: Please rub the table until it shines.
s1_cn: 请把桌子擦到发亮。
s2_en: He rubbed his hands to keep warm.
s2_cn: 他搓手取暖。
s3_en: Rub the stain with a clean cloth.
s3_cn: 用干净布擦掉污渍。

s1_en: Every employee must follow the safety rules in the workshop.
s1_cn: 每位员工必须遵守车间的安全规则。
s2_en: The new rule requires double inspection for critical parts.
s2_cn: 新规则要求关键零件双重检验。
s3_en: We updated the quality rule based on customer feedback.
s3_cn: 我们根据客户反馈更新了质量规则。

s1_en: Finance ran the numbers and the project barely breaks even.
s1_cn: 财务核算了数据，项目仅勉强盈亏平衡。
s2_en: She runs a tight ship in the logistics department.
s2_cn: 她在物流部门管理严格、井井有条。
s3_en: The candidate pool ran dry after the hiring freeze.
s3_cn: 招聘冻结后，候选人储备枯竭了。

cn: n. 盐；v. 撒盐；盐处理
s1_en: The salt spray test proved the chassis coating lasts ten years.
s1_cn: 盐雾测试证明底盘涂层能用十年。
s2_en: We salt the roads in winter, so we test every seal against corrosion.
s2_cn: 冬季道路会撒盐，因此我们对每个密封件都做耐腐蚀测试。
s3_en: A pinch of salt in the analogy helps, but the data must still hold.
s3_cn: 这个类比稍加点"盐"无妨，但数据本身必须站得住。

s1_en: The beach is covered with sand.
s1_cn: 海滩上覆盖着沙子。
s2_en: We use sand to test the paint finish.
s2_cn: 我们用沙子测试漆面。
s3_en: The wind blew the sand into the air.
s3_cn: 风把沙子吹向空中。

cn: n. 规模；刻度；v. 扩大规模；缩放
s1_en: We achieve lower cost through economies of scale.
s1_cn: 我们通过规模经济实现更低的成本。
s2_en: The plant runs at a scale of 500,000 units a year.
s2_cn: 该工厂以每年50万辆的规模运行。
s3_en: Scaling up too fast can strain quality control.
s3_cn: 过快扩张规模会拖累质量控制。

cn: n. 科学；n. 学科；严谨方法
s1_en: Data science turned three years of field logs into a failure forecast.
s1_cn: 数据科学把三年的现场日志转化成了故障预测。
s2_en: Materials science gave us a lighter seat frame without losing strength.
s2_cn: 材料科学让我们在不损失强度的前提下，做出更轻的座椅骨架。
s3_en: Good management is a science of trade-offs, not a matter of gut feel.
s3_cn: 好的管理是一门权衡的科学，而非凭直觉。

s1_en: The expo drew a sea of visitors, and our booth booked record test drives.
s1_cn: 展会吸引了大量观众，我们的展台创纪录地接到了试驾预约。
s2_en: The export route crosses the sea, so we pack each car for a long voyage.
s2_cn: 出口航线跨海，因此我们对每辆车的包装都按长途海运来做。
s3_en: A sea of red on the dashboard means stop and trace the fault now.
s3_cn: 看板上大片红色意味着立即停线并追溯故障。

s1_en: The driver's seat adjusts for long-haul comfort.
s1_cn: 驾驶员座椅可调节，提升长途舒适性。
s2_en: We recall 12,000 seats over a weld defect.
s2_cn: 我们因焊接缺陷召回了12000个座椅。
s3_en: Seat quality is checked on the line by laser scan.
s3_cn: 座椅质量在产线上通过激光扫描检查。

cn: n. 秘书；n. 干事；书记
s1_en: The company secretary filed the board minutes before the deadline.
s1_cn: 公司秘书在截止日前归档了董事会纪要。
s2_en: A skilled secretary keeps the launch war room running on time.
s2_cn: 一位干练的秘书让上市作战室准时运转。
s3_en: We trained a secretary to own the audit tracker end to end.
s3_cn: 我们培训了一位干事端到端负责审计跟踪表。

s1_en: The shop has a wide selection of cars.
s1_cn: 这家店有丰富的车型可选。
s2_en: His selection was the red one.
s2_cn: 他选的是红色那辆。
s3_en: Making a good selection takes time.
s3_cn: 做出好选择需要时间。

s1_en: The station runs a self-check before each part to catch defects early.
s1_cn: 工位在每个零件前都会自检，以及早抓出缺陷。
s2_en: Self-learning modules let new hires train without pulling an instructor.
s2_cn: 自学模块让新员工无需占用讲师就能受训。
s3_en: A clear sense of self drives owners to close their own findings.
s3_cn: 清晰的自我要求，促使责任人主动关闭自己的发现项。

cn: n. 感觉；感官；n. 意识；观念；n. 意义；道理
s1_en: He has a strong sense of duty.
s1_cn: 他有很强的责任感。
s2_en: The sense of touch is on the skin.
s2_cn: 触觉在皮肤上。
s3_en: She lost her sense of direction.
s3_cn: 她失去了方向感。

cn: n. 仆人；n. 服务人员
s1_en: The fleet manager is a servant of the driver, not the other way around.
s1_cn: 车队管理者是驾驶者的服务者，而非相反。
s2_en: A good tool is a servant that frees the worker from repeat strain.
s2_cn: 好的工具是服务者，把工人从重复劳损中解放出来。
s3_en: We train service staff as servants of the owner experience, not just repair.
s3_cn: 我们把服务人员培训成车主体验的服务者，而非只做维修。

s1_en: The form asks for your sex and age.
s1_cn: 表格要求填写性别和年龄。
s2_en: There is no sex difference in this test.
s2_cn: 这项测试没有性别差异。
s3_en: Both sexes should be treated fairly.
s3_cn: 男女都应被公平对待。

s1_en: Let us sit in the shade of the tree.
s1_cn: 我们在树荫下坐坐吧。
s2_en: The shade of the hat kept the sun off.
s2_cn: 帽子的阴影挡住了阳光。
s3_en: The color is a darker shade of blue.
s3_cn: 这是更深一层的蓝色。

s1_en: The two CEOs shook hands on the joint venture.
s1_cn: 两位CEO为合资项目握手。
s2_en: Shake the sample before the lab test.
s2_cn: 实验前先摇匀样品。
s3_en: The recall shook confidence in the brand.
s3_cn: 这次召回动摇了消费者对该品牌的信心。

cn: n. 遗憾；憾事；v. 使相形见绌；使羞愧
s1_en: Our defect rate put the old benchmark to shame after the retrain.
s1_cn: 重新培训后，我们的缺陷率让旧标杆相形见绌。
s2_en: It is a shame to waste a good idea, so we log every suggestion.
s2_cn: 浪费一个好点子很可惜，因此我们把每条建议都记下来。
s3_en: The rival's launch put us to shame, so we rewrote the plan overnight.
s3_cn: 对手的上市让我们自愧不如，于是我们连夜重写了计划。

s1_en: The car’s shock absorber keeps the ride smooth.
s1_cn: 汽车的减震器让行驶更平稳。
s2_en: We test the shock on rough roads.
s2_cn: 我们在崎岖路面测试减震器。
s3_en: Replace the shock if it leaks oil.
s3_cn: 如果减震器漏油就把它换掉。

s1_en: We came down on the side of quality when cost and speed pulled apart.
s1_cn: 当成本与速度冲突时，我们站在质量这一边。
s2_en: The business side and the plant side met weekly to clear blockers.
s2_cn: 商务侧与工厂侧每周碰面，清除卡点。
s3_en: The robot welds both sides of the bracket in one pass, saving a flip.
s3_cn: 机器人一次走过就焊好支架两侧，省去翻面。

cn: n. 标志；迹象；v. 签字；示意
s1_en: The quality lead signed off the run only after the last defect closed.
s1_cn: 质量负责人在最后一个缺陷关闭后才签核了这批生产。
s2_en: A drop in claims is a good sign that the design fix worked.
s2_cn: 索赔量下降是个好迹象，说明设计整改奏效了。
s3_en: We read the market sign and pulled the launch forward by two weeks.
s3_cn: 我们读懂了市场信号，把上市提前了两周。

s1_en: The limited edition uses silk trim on the pillar.
s1_cn: 限量版在立柱上采用丝绸饰条。
s2_en: Silk blends cut the cost of the headliner.
s2_cn: 丝绸混纺降低了顶棚面料成本。
s3_en: We test silk for color fastness in sunlight.
s3_cn: 我们测试丝绸在日照下的色牢度。

cn: n. 银；银色；adj. 银的；银色的
s1_en: The silver lining of the delay was time to add the safety feature.
s1_cn: 延迟带来的一线希望，是腾出了时间加上安全功能。
s2_en: The trim uses silver anodizing to resist scratches on the console.
s2_cn: 饰条采用银色阳极氧化，以抗控制台上的划痕。
s3_en: Silver in the solder keeps the high-voltage joint reliable for years.
s3_cn: 焊料中的银，使高压接点多年保持可靠。

cn: n. 姐妹；姊妹公司（关联企业）
s1_en: Our sister company supplies the braking system.
s1_cn: 我们的姊妹公司供应制动系统。
s2_en: The sister company in Brazil handles local assembly.
s2_cn: 我们在巴西的姊妹公司负责本地组装。
s3_en: We share the platform with the sister company.
s3_cn: 我们与姊妹公司共用该平台。

meanings.cn: 姐妹；姊妹公司（关联企业）

cn: n. 尺寸；规模；v. 确定尺寸；调整
s1_en: We sized up the new market before committing a single production line.
s1_cn: 在投入任何一条产线前，我们先估量了新市场。
s2_en: The team sized the battery pack to hit both range and cost targets.
s2_cn: 团队把电池包尺寸定在既能达标续航、又能达标成本的范围。
s3_en: Plant size grew from one to three halls in just four years.
s3_cn: 工厂规模在仅四年内从一跨车间扩到三跨。

cn: n. 天空；n. 上限；极限
s1_en: With the new platform, the sky is the limit on derivative models.
s1_cn: 有了新平台，衍生车型的潜力就没有上限。
s2_en: The test car climbed to thin sky to prove the turbo holds boost.
s2_cn: 测试车爬到稀薄的高空，以验证涡轮保压能力。
s3_en: A clear sky on launch day let the drone film the event from above.
s3_cn: 上市当天晴空万里，无人机得以从空中拍摄活动。

s1_en: Let's sleep on the acquisition offer before we commit.
s1_cn: 在决定前，我们先把收购要约放一晚再考虑。
s2_en: The CFO loses sleep over the currency exposure.
s2_cn: 首席财务官为汇率风险敞口而焦虑。
s3_en: A clear risk plan let the board sleep at night.
s3_cn: 一份清晰的风险预案让董事会安心。

s1_en: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor.
s1_cn: 小心别在湿地板上滑倒。
s2_en: The paper slipped from my hand.
s2_cn: 纸从我的手里滑落。
s3_en: She slipped the letter into the box.
s3_cn: 她把信悄悄塞进了盒子。

s1_en: The car climbed the steep slope.
s1_cn: 汽车爬上了陡坡。
s2_en: Be careful on the slippery slope.
s2_cn: 在湿滑的斜坡上要小心。
s3_en: We measured the slope of the test hill.
s3_cn: 我们测量了测试山坡的坡度。

cn: v. 粉碎；猛击；n. 大成功（口语）
s1_en: The plant smashed a record by building its ten-millionth unit this quarter.
s1_cn: 工厂本季度产出第千万台，大幅打破纪录。
s2_en: The crash test smashes the car into the barrier to prove cabin safety.
s2_cn: 碰撞测试让车撞向障碍壁，以验证座舱安全。
s3_en: The launch event was a smash, drawing dealers from twelve regions.
s3_cn: 这场上市活动大获成功，吸引了十二个区域的经销商。

s1_en: The engineer smelled of a coolant leak before the sensor even flagged it.
s1_cn: 工程师在传感器报警前就嗅出了冷却液泄漏的迹象。
s2_en: A burnt smell from the motor sent the line into a safe stop.
s2_cn: 电机散发的焦糊味让产线安全停机。
s3_en: Good QA can smell of a problem in the data long before it ships.
s3_cn: 好的质检能在问题流出前很久，就从数据里嗅出异常。

s1_en: Fortune smiled on the launch when the key part arrived a day early.
s1_cn: 幸运向上市绽开了微笑——关键件提前一天到了。
s2_en: A smile from the dealer meant the new terms were finally accepted.
s2_cn: 经销商的一个微笑，意味着新条款终于被接受。
s3_en: The service advisor's smile kept the upset owner calm during the wait.
s3_cn: 服务顾问的微笑，让不满的车主在等待时保持了平静。

cn: n. 烟；烟雾；v. 吸烟；冒烟
s1_en: Smoke came out of the chimney.
s1_cn: 烟从烟囱里冒出来。
s2_en: Please do not smoke in the office.
s2_cn: 请别在办公室吸烟。
s3_en: The smoke from the fire was thick.
s3_cn: 火灾的烟很浓。

s1_en: The cost saving from the lighter bracket is not to be sneezed at.
s1_cn: 更轻支架带来的成本节省，可不容小觑。
s2_en: He sneezed through the night shift but still closed the line audit on time.
s2_cn: 他打着喷嚏上完夜班，仍按时关闭了产线审核。
s3_en: A small defect in a sensor is not to be sneezed at in a safety system.
s3_cn: 安全系统里传感器的一个小缺陷，也绝不可小觑。

s1_en: The cost saving snowballed after we fixed the root cause plant-wide.
s1_cn: 在全厂根治根因后，成本节省像滚雪球一样越积越多。
s2_en: The test fleet ran through snow to prove the winter-tire strategy.
s2_cn: 测试车队在雪地里跑，以验证冬季胎策略。
s3_en: Heavy snow delayed the trucks, so we pulled stock from the backup hub.
s3_cn: 大雪延误了卡车，于是我们从备用枢纽调货。

cn: n. 肥皂；v. 用肥皂洗
s1_en: Soap and water still beat most shortcuts when cleaning a work surface.
s1_cn: 清洁工作台面时，肥皂加水仍胜过多数偷懒做法。
s2_en: The plant hands out soap and sanitiser to keep the floor healthy.
s2_cn: 工厂发放肥皂和洗手液，保持车间卫生。
s3_en: We soap the mold release off parts before the final coat goes on.
s3_cn: 我们在喷最后一道漆前，把零件上的脱模剂洗掉。

s1_en: The plant gave back to society at large through a local STEM program.
s1_cn: 工厂通过本地 STEM 项目回馈社会大众。
s2_en: The automotive society certified our engineers on the new standard.
s2_cn: 汽车协会就新标准为我们工程师做了认证。
s3_en: A clean factory earns trust from the society around it.
s3_cn: 干净的工厂赢得了周边社会的信任。

s1_en: The founder's son took over as CEO.
s1_cn: 创始人之子接任了CEO。
s2_en: The son of the owner now leads the overseas unit.
s2_cn: 老板的儿子现在执掌海外业务单元。
s3_en: A family firm often passes power to the son.
s3_cn: 家族企业常把权力传给儿子。

meanings.cn: 儿子；创始人之子（家族传承）

phrase_cn: 唱同一个调子（口径一致）
s1_en: Sales and plant sang the same song on volume, so the plan held.
s1_cn: 销售与工厂在产量上口径一致，计划因此稳住了。
s2_en: The brand's song in the ad was built around freedom and safety.
s2_cn: 广告里品牌的调子围绕自由与安全展开。
s3_en: A good jingle is a song the customer hums long after the show.
s3_cn: 好的广告歌，是客户在车展后很久还会哼的调子。

cn: n. 种类；各式各样；v. 分类；整理
s1_en: We stock all sorts of parts for the model.
s1_cn: 我们为这款车型备齐了各式各样的零部件。
s2_en: Please sort the invoices by due date.
s2_cn: 请按到期日整理发票。
s3_en: Sort the defects by root cause before the review.
s3_cn: 评审前按根本原因对缺陷分类。

cn: n. 声音；v. 听起来；adj. 合理的；可靠的
s1_en: The plan rested on sound reasoning from three years of field data.
s1_cn: 该计划建立在三年现场数据得出的合理推理之上。
s2_en: The ADAS emitted a sound to warn the driver of a lane drift.
s2_cn: 辅助驾驶发出一声提示音，警告驾驶者偏离车道。
s3_en: His cost case sounds simple, but the math behind it is solid.
s3_cn: 他的成本论证听起来简单，但背后的数据很扎实。

cn: n. 汤；n. 糊状物；混合体
phrase_cn: 一团乱麻（多而杂的缩略语）
s1_en: The spec was an alphabet soup of abbreviations, so we wrote a glossary.
s1_cn: 那份规范是一团缩略语乱麻，于是我们写了术语表。
s2_en: The canteen's soup won the highest score in the staff satisfaction poll.
s2_cn: 食堂的汤在员工满意度调查里拿了最高分。
s3_en: We turned the data soup into one clean dashboard for the line lead.
s3_cn: 我们把杂乱的数据整合成一块干净的看板，给产线主管用。

cn: n. 空间；空地；v. 留间隔；拉开
s1_en: We spaced out the shifts so the canteen never overcrowded at changeover.
s1_cn: 我们把班次拉开间隔，使换型时食堂不拥挤。
s2_en: The new layout freed floor space for a third inspection station.
s2_cn: 新布局腾出了地面空间，得以增设第三个检验工位。
s3_en: Cabin space became the top reason fleet buyers chose our van.
s3_cn: 座舱空间成了大客户选择我们厢式车的首要原因。

s1_en: The project is at the pilot stage this quarter.
s1_cn: 本项目本季度处于试产阶段。
s2_en: We review the plan at every stage of development.
s2_cn: 我们在开发的每个阶段评审方案。
s3_en: The new model moves to the mass-production stage.
s3_cn: 新车型进入量产阶段。

s1_en: We saw a bright star in the night sky.
s1_cn: 我们在夜空中看到一颗明亮的星星。
s2_en: The north star shows the direction.
s2_cn: 北极星指示方向。
s3_en: She is a rising star in the team.
s3_cn: 她是团队里的新星。

s1_en: The operator will start the machine at the start of each shift.
s1_cn: 操作员每个班次开始时会开始机器。
s2_en: We plan to start in the next development cycle.
s2_cn: 我们计划在下一个开发周期开始。
s3_en: The supplier failed to start within the agreed timeframe.
s3_cn: 供应商未能在约定时间内开始。

cn: n. 声明；陈述；n. 报表
s1_en: Our mission statement puts customer trust above every quarterly number.
s1_cn: 我们的使命宣言把客户信任放在每个季度数字之上。
s2_en: The monthly statement showed scrap down and uptime up, quarter on quarter.
s2_cn: 月度报表显示报废下降、开机率上升，环比向好。
s3_en: The CEO's statement on quality reassured dealers before the launch.
s3_cn: CEO 关于质量的声明，在上市前让经销商放了心。

s1_en: The new model picked up steam after a strong review from fleet buyers.
s1_cn: 在获得大客户好评后，新车型声势渐起。
s2_en: The steam press forms the hood in one hot stroke without a seam.
s2_cn: 蒸汽压机一次热压成形发动机盖，不留接缝。
s3_en: The ramp picked up steam once the second line cleared its teething issues.
s3_cn: 在第二条产线度过磨合期后，爬坡提速了。

s1_en: The body structure uses high-strength steel for crash safety.
s1_cn: 车身结构使用高强度钢以保证碰撞安全性。
s2_en: Steel prices have increased by 12% this quarter.
s2_cn: 本季度钢材价格上涨了12%。
s3_en: We source steel from three approved suppliers.
s3_cn: 我们从三家批准的供应商采购钢材。

cn: n. 步骤；台阶；v. 迈步；介入
s1_en: We stepped up output by adding a weekend shift during the peak season.
s1_cn: 旺季里我们增加周末班次，提升了产量。
s2_en: Each step in the build is logged so a fault traces to one owner.
s2_cn: 制造的每个步骤都有记录，使故障能追溯到单一责任人。
s3_en: The team stepped up when the launch slipped and pulled it back on track.
s3_cn: 在上市延迟时，团队挺身而出，把它拉回正轨。

s1_en: Continuous stitch improvement reduced cycle time by 12 percent.
s1_cn: 持续的针脚改善使循环时间缩短了12%。
s2_en: We standardized the stitch procedure across all three plants.
s2_cn: 我们在三个工厂标准化了针脚程序。
s3_en: The stitch process is validated before mass production begins.
s3_cn: 量产开始前验证针脚工艺。

s1_en: A stone chip cracked the headlight lens.
s1_cn: 飞石磕裂了大灯镜片。
s2_en: We test paint for stone-chip resistance.
s2_cn: 我们测试漆面的抗飞石性能。
s3_en: The test road is paved with rough stone.
s3_cn: 测试道路由粗糙的石块铺成。

cn: n. 停止；站点；v. 停止；阻止
s1_en: Any safety doubt lets the worker stop the line without asking permission.
s1_cn: 任何安全疑虑都允许工人不经请示就停线。
s2_en: The bus stop near the gate helps staff reach the plant without a car.
s2_cn: 大门附近的公交站，让员工不用开车也能到厂。
s3_en: We stop the root cause, not just the symptom, so the defect stays gone.
s3_cn: 我们消除的是根因而非表象，使缺陷不再出现。

cn: n. 故事；情况；n. 报道；说法
s1_en: The brand tells a story of safety that dealers can repeat with conviction.
s1_cn: 该品牌讲述了一个安全的故事，经销商能笃定地复述。
s2_en: The data tells a clear story: the retrain cut claims by a third.
s2_cn: 数据讲了一个清楚的事实：重新培训把索赔降了三分之一。
s3_en: Every car has a story from the line that built it, good or bad.
s3_cn: 每辆车都带着制造它的产线的故事，好或坏。

cn: v. 伸展；拉长；n. 一段（路程/时间）
s1_en: A stretch of stable demand let us hold price without a raise.
s1_cn: 一段需求平稳期，让我们得以保持价格不涨。
s2_en: We stretched the line to three shifts to clear the backlog before month-end.
s2_cn: 我们把产线拉到三班倒，以在月底清掉积压。
s3_en: The robot arm stretches to reach the far bolt without a reposition.
s3_cn: 机械臂伸展够到远处的螺栓，无需重新定位。

cn: n. 结构；构造；v. 构建；组织
s1_en: The new platform cut the cost structure by sharing parts across models.
s1_cn: 新平台通过跨车型共用零件，降低了成本结构。
s2_en: We structured the team by value stream, not by old functional silos.
s2_cn: 我们按价值流而非旧职能竖井来构建团队。
s3_en: The body structure uses high-strength steel to protect the cabin in a crash.
s3_cn: 车身结构采用高强度钢，在碰撞中保护座舱。

s1_en: Water is a clear substance.
s1_cn: 水是一种清澈的物质。
s2_en: The substance is safe to touch.
s2_cn: 这种物质接触安全。
s3_en: Iron is a hard substance.
s3_cn: 铁是一种坚硬的物质。

s1_en: We ship raw sugar to the food client.
s1_cn: 我们向食品客户发运原糖。
s2_en: The sugar order met the quality spec.
s2_cn: 食糖订单符合质量规范。
s3_en: A sugar shortage raised our costs.
s3_cn: 食糖短缺推高了我们的成本。

s1_en: The line worker made a suggestion that saved two seconds per door.
s1_cn: 产线工人提了一条建议，每个车门省下两秒。
s2_en: We log every suggestion so a good idea never gets lost in the shift.
s2_cn: 我们把每条建议都记下来，好点子就不会在班次里流失。
s3_en: His suggestion to dual-source the chip avoided a month-long stop.
s3_cn: 他关于芯片双货源的建议，避免了一个月的停产。

s1_en: Maintenance is scheduled during low-production summer.
s1_cn: 维护安排在低产夏天。
s2_en: The summer shift reported zero safety incidents.
s2_cn: 夏天班次报告零安全事故。
s3_en: Production targets are tracked per summer.
s3_cn: 生产目标按每夏天跟踪。

cn: n. 支持；v. 支持；支撑
s1_en: Technical support resolved the line fault within the hour, not the next day.
s1_cn: 技术支持在一小时内而非次日解决了产线故障。
s2_en: The bracket supports the screen so it stays put over rough roads.
s2_cn: 支架支撑着屏幕，使它在烂路上也不晃动。
s3_en: We support our dealers with training, not just with a price list.
s3_cn: 我们给经销商的是培训支持，而不只是一张价目表。

cn: n. 惊讶；意外；v. 使惊讶；突袭
s1_en: A surprise audit found a gap in the traceability documentation.
s1_cn: 突击审计发现了可追溯性文档的缺口。
s2_en: We conduct surprise inspections to verify process compliance.
s2_cn: 我们进行突击检查以验证工艺合规性。
s3_en: The surprise quality check revealed a calibration drift in the robot.
s3_cn: 突击质量检查发现了机器人的校准漂移。

s1_en: After the IPO the firm was swimming in cash.
s1_cn: IPO之后，公司资金充裕。
s2_en: We cannot swim against the market trend forever.
s2_cn: 我们无法长期逆市场趋势而行。
s3_en: The unit swam back to profit after the restructure.
s3_cn: 该业务单元重组后重新盈利。

meanings.cn: 游泳；充溢；逆势而行（口语）

s1_en: The quality management system flagged the drift before a single bad car shipped.
s1_cn: 质量管理体系在任一辆不良车流出前就标出了偏移。
s2_en: We linked the robot to the MES so the system logs every cycle automatically.
s2_cn: 我们把机器人接入制造执行系统，使其自动记录每个节拍。
s3_en: A clean system design kept the launch free of the old integration bugs.
s3_cn: 干净的系统设计，让上市摆脱了旧式集成缺陷。

cn: n. 谈话；演讲；v. 谈话；沟通
s1_en: We talked over the spec with the supplier and cut two needless tests.
s1_cn: 我们和供应商商议了规范，砍掉两项不必要的测试。
s2_en: The keynote talk drew a full hall of dealers to the new brand plan.
s2_cn: 主题演讲让经销商满场聆听了新的品牌计划。
s3_en: Money talks, but on the floor, data talks louder than opinion.
s3_cn: 资金有分量，但在现场，数据比看法更有说服力。

cn: n. 味道；品味；v. 尝；体验
s1_en: The soup has a salty taste.
s1_cn: 这汤有咸味。
s2_en: She has good taste in music.
s2_cn: 她对音乐很有品味。
s3_en: Please taste the dish and tell me.
s3_cn: 请尝尝这道菜再告诉我。

s1_en: The new plant qualifies for a corporate tax holiday.
s1_cn: 新工厂符合企业所得税减免资格。
s2_en: We optimized the supply chain to lower the import tax.
s2_cn: 我们优化了供应链，以降低进口税。
s3_en: The CFO reviewed the R&D tax credit with the advisors.
s3_cn: 首席财务官与顾问复核了研发费用税收抵免。

s1_en: The new teaching method cut new-hire training from six weeks to three.
s1_cn: 新教学方法把新员工培训从六周缩短到三周。
s2_en: His teaching on root-cause analysis shaped a whole generation of engineers.
s2_cn: 他关于根因分析的教学，塑造了一整代工程师。
s3_en: We record the teaching as short clips so the line can replay any step.
s3_cn: 我们把教学内容录成短片，产线可随时回看任一步骤。

s1_en: There is a tendency for prices to rise.
s1_cn: 价格有上涨的趋势。
s2_en: He has a tendency to arrive late.
s2_cn: 他有迟到的习惯。
s3_en: The market shows a clear tendency.
s3_cn: 市场呈现出明显的趋势。

cn: n. 测试；试验；v. 测试；检验
s1_en: The crash test results met all safety requirements.
s1_cn: 碰撞测试结果满足所有安全要求。
s2_en: We need to test the new material under extreme conditions.
s2_cn: 我们需要在极端条件下测试新材料。
s3_en: The durability test will run for 100,000 kilometers.
s3_cn: 耐久性测试将进行10万公里。

s1_en: In theory the cycle time was fine, but the floor told a different story.
s1_cn: 理论上节拍时间没问题，但现场情况并非如此。
s2_en: The theory of constraints showed the bottleneck was at the weld, not paint.
s2_cn: 约束理论指出瓶颈在焊接而非涂装。
s3_en: Good theory meets hard data, or it stays an idea on a slide.
s3_cn: 好的理论要碰到硬数据，否则只是幻灯片上的点子。

s1_en: The prototype is the real thing, not a mock-up.
s1_cn: 这台原型车是实物，不是模型。
s2_en: We ship the whole thing as a kit.
s2_cn: 我们把整个东西作为套件发货。
s3_en: The first thing each morning is the safety check.
s3_cn: 每天早上的第一件事是安全检查。

cn: n. 想法；思考；v. 思考（think 过去式）
s1_en: On second thought, we dropped the chrome option to protect the margin.
s1_cn: 转念一想，我们砍掉了镀铬选装以保住毛利。
s2_en: His thought on supplier risk changed how we qualify new sources.
s2_cn: 他关于供应风险的思考，改变了我们筛选新货源的方式。
s3_en: A quiet thought in the war room often beats a loud debate.
s3_cn: 作战室里一个安静的思考，往往胜过一场高声争论。

cn: n. 雷；v. 轰鸣；轰隆推进
s1_en: The prototype thundered past on the banked track to prove its high-speed poise.
s1_cn: 原型车在倾斜赛道上轰鸣驶过，以验证高速下的稳定。
s2_en: The launch announcement thundered across the industry and lifted bookings.
s2_cn: 上市发布在行业内引起轰动，订单随之上涨。
s3_en: We test the audio system against thunder so the cabin stays calm inside.
s3_cn: 我们让音响系统对抗雷声测试，使座舱内部保持安静。

cn: n. 时间；时段；n. 次；倍；n. 时机；时刻
s1_en: Cycle time reduction on Line 3 improved output by 15 percent.
s1_cn: 3号线循环时间缩短使产量提升了15%。
s2_en: We track time from order to delivery as a key performance metric.
s2_cn: 我们追踪从下单到交付的时间作为关键绩效指标。
s3_en: The time study identified three bottleneck operations in the assembly.
s3_cn: 时间研究发现了装配中的三个瓶颈工序。

s1_en: Tin plating on the terminal keeps the joint from corroding in humid markets.
s1_cn: 端子上的镀锡，使接点在潮湿市场里不生锈。
s2_en: The solder uses a tin mix that meets the lead-free compliance rule.
s2_cn: 焊料采用锡基配方，符合无铅合规要求。
s3_en: We recycle tin from the scrap boards, turning waste into a small profit.
s3_cn: 我们从报废电路板上回收锡，把废料变成小额收益。

s1_en: The book is at the top of the shelf.
s1_cn: 书在架子顶部。
s2_en: He climbed to the top of the hill.
s2_cn: 他爬到了山顶。
s3_en: Please put your name at the top.
s3_cn: 请把名字写在最上方。

cn: n. 触；触感；v. 触摸；涉及
s1_en: The keynote touched on three markets where we plan to launch next.
s1_cn: 主题演讲提到了我们计划下一步上市的三个市场。
s2_en: The soft-touch trim gave the cabin a premium feel at low cost.
s2_cn: 软触感饰条以低成本让座舱显出高端质感。
s3_en: No one should touch the high-voltage pack without the certified badge.
s3_cn: 没有持证标识，任何人不得触碰高压电池包。

cn: n. 贸易；行业；v. 交易；交换
s1_en: The trade show gave us face time with thirty fleet buyers in two days.
s1_cn: 行业展会让我们两天内面见了三十位大客户采购。
s2_en: We traded the heavier part for a composite one and cut mass by ten percent.
s2_cn: 我们用复合材料件换下较重的件，减重 10%。
s3_en: Fair trade terms kept the small supplier loyal through a price swing.
s3_cn: 公平的贸易条款，让这家小供应商在价格波动中保持忠诚。

cn: n. 运输；交通；v. 运输；运送
s1_en: We optimized the parts transport route to reduce costs.
s1_cn: 我们优化了零件运输路线以降低成本。
s2_en: The logistics team handles vehicle transport to dealers.
s2_cn: 物流团队负责向经销商运输车辆。
s3_en: All transport must comply with packaging standards.
s3_cn: 所有运输必须符合包装标准。

cn: n. 诀窍；妙招；v. 哄骗
s1_en: The trick of the trade is to set the fixture once, then run it all shift.
s1_cn: 行业诀窍是先把夹具调定，然后整班运行。
s2_en: A simple trick cut changeover time: stage the next part before the run ends.
s2_cn: 一个小妙招缩短了换型时间：在当班结束前就把下个件备好。
s3_en: We never trick a customer with hidden fees; the quote shows all in.
s3_cn: 我们从不以隐藏费用哄骗客户，报价里一切明示。

cn: n. 麻烦；故障；v. 费心；打扰
s1_en: The team troubleshot the sensor fault in twenty minutes, not two days.
s1_cn: 团队用二十分钟而非两天排查出了传感器故障。
s2_en: A small trouble at the seal grew into a recall, so we watch every signal.
s2_cn: 密封处的小故障发展成召回，因此我们盯紧每一个信号。
s3_en: Do not trouble the engineer unless the line is truly down.
s3_cn: 除非产线真的停了，否则不要打扰工程师。

cn: v. 转动；转向；n. 轮流；轮次；n. 转弯；拐弯
s1_en: Please turn the key to start.
s1_cn: 请转动钥匙启动。
s2_en: It is your turn to speak.
s2_cn: 轮到你发言了。
s3_en: The road turns to the left.
s3_cn: 路向左转。

cn: n. 扭转；转折；v. 扭转；拧
s1_en: The twist in the tale was the cheap part that caused the whole failure.
s1_cn: 出乎意料的转折是，那个便宜件导致了整个失效。
s2_en: We twist the torsion beam to tune the ride without adding weight.
s2_cn: 我们扭转扭力梁来调校驾乘，而不增加重量。
s3_en: A late design twist saved the program when the first supplier failed.
s3_cn: 一个迟来的设计调整，在第一家供应商掉链子时挽救了项目。

cn: n. 单位；单元；n. 部件；一台（设备）
s1_en: The meter is a unit of length.
s1_cn: 米是长度单位。
s2_en: We sold 100 units last week.
s2_cn: 上周我们卖了100台。
s3_en: Each unit was checked before shipping.
s3_cn: 每台在发货前都检查过。

cn: v. 使用；运用；n. 用途；用处
s1_en: We make use of solar energy.
s1_cn: 我们利用太阳能。
s2_en: What is the use of this tool?
s2_cn: 这个工具有什么用途？
s3_en: Please use the red pen to sign.
s3_cn: 请用红笔签字。

cn: n. 价值；v. 重视；评价
s1_en: Reliable delivery builds long-term value for our customers.
s1_cn: 可靠的交付为客户创造长期价值。
s2_en: This feature adds real value to the daily drive.
s2_cn: 这个特性为日常驾驶增添了实在价值。
s3_en: The team discussed how to raise value without raising cost.
s3_cn: 团队讨论了如何在不增加成本的前提下提升价值。

s1_en: The audit cited chapter and verse on every finding, so no one could dispute it.
s1_cn: 审计对每项发现都引了确切依据，无人能反驳。
s2_en: The training opens with a verse on safety that every new hire learns by heart.
s2_cn: 培训以一段关于安全的诗句开场，每位新员工都背下来。
s3_en: He quoted the standard chapter and verse to win the design argument.
s3_cn: 他引了标准确切条款，赢得了那场设计争论。

s1_en: The factory uses a large vessel to mix the liquid.
s1_cn: 工厂用大容器来混合液体。
s2_en: A vessel carried the parts across the sea.
s2_cn: 一艘船把零件运过了海。
s3_en: The cooking vessel must be clean.
s3_cn: 烹饪容器必须保持干净。

cn: n. 景色；风景；n. 观点；看法；v. 看待；考虑
s1_en: The hill gives a fine view of the city.
s1_cn: 从山丘上能俯瞰城市美景。
s2_en: In my view, the plan is sound.
s2_cn: 在我看来，这个计划是稳妥的。
s3_en: We stopped to enjoy the view.
s3_cn: 我们停下来欣赏风景。

cn: n. 声音；嗓音；v. 表达；吐露
s1_en: She spoke in a clear voice.
s1_cn: 她说话声音清晰。
s2_en: The singer has a beautiful voice.
s2_cn: 这位歌手嗓音优美。
s3_en: We heard his voice on the phone.
s3_cn: 我们在电话里听到他的声音。

cn: n. 走路；散步；v. 退出（walk away）；走查（walk through）；言行一致（walk the talk）
s1_en: Leaders must walk the talk on safety, not just announce it.
s1_cn: 领导者必须在安全上言行一致，而不只是发号施令。
s2_en: We walked away from the unfair contract.
s2_cn: 我们退出了那份不公平的合同。
s3_en: The trainer walked the new hires through the compliance steps.
s3_cn: 培训师向新员工逐步讲解了合规步骤。

meanings.cn: 退出（walk away）；走查（walk through）；言行一致（walk the talk）

cn: n. 竞争；角逐；v. 作战；角逐
s1_en: The launch war room met at seven to clear every blocker before the shift.
s1_cn: 上市作战室七点碰头，在班次前清除每个卡点。
s2_en: We won the price war by cutting cost, not by cutting the warranty.
s2_cn: 我们靠降本而非砍保修，赢下了价格战。
s3_en: The two plants waged a friendly war on scrap and both came out leaner.
s3_cn: 两家工厂打了一场友好的报废竞赛，双方都变得更精简。

s1_en: The VP washed his hands of the failed venture and resigned.
s1_cn: 副总裁对失败的项目撒手不管，并辞了职。
s2_en: Weak suppliers were washed out in the quality audit.
s2_cn: 实力薄弱的供应商在质量审核中被淘汰。
s3_en: We cannot wash our hands of the defect once it reaches the customer.
s3_cn: 一旦缺陷到了客户手中，我们就不能置身事外。

cn: n. 浪费；废料；v. 浪费
s1_en: Waste not is the rule: we size each blank so off-cut hits near zero.
s1_cn: "不浪费"是准则：我们把每块板坯尺寸定到边角料近乎为零。
s2_en: The plant turned weld waste into a recycled stream that funds training.
s2_cn: 工厂把焊接废料变成回收流，用以资助培训。
s3_en: A minute of downtime wastes a full shift's target, so we guard every second.
s3_cn: 一分钟停机就浪费一个班的产量目标，因此我们守住每一秒。

s1_en: The SUV passed the deep-water test.
s1_cn: 这款SUV通过了深水涉水测试。
s2_en: We test the seal against water ingress.
s2_cn: 我们测试密封以防进水。
s3_en: Water leakage triggered a warranty claim.
s3_cn: 漏水引发了一起保修索赔。

cn: n. 波浪；挥手；电波（radio wave）；浪潮（heat wave）
s1_en: Radio waves carry the keyless entry signal.
s1_cn: 无线电波承载着无钥匙进入的信号。
s2_en: She gave a wave from the show stand.
s2_cn: 她在展台上挥手致意。
s3_en: A heat wave disrupted the plant's cooling system.
s3_cn: 一波热浪打乱了工厂的冷却系统。

meanings.cn: 波浪；挥手；电波（radio wave）；浪潮（heat wave）

s1_en: The candle is made of wax.
s1_cn: 蜡烛是蜡做的。
s2_en: He used wax to seal the box.
s2_cn: 他用蜡封住箱子。
s3_en: The wax melted in the heat.
s3_cn: 蜡受热融化了。

s1_en: This is the best way to save time.
s1_cn: 这是节省时间的最好方式。
s2_en: We found a new way to cut cost.
s2_cn: 我们找到了降低成本的新方法。
s3_en: The way to the plant is on the left.
s3_cn: 去工厂的路在左边。

cn: n. 天气；v. 经受住；熬过
s1_en: The supplier weathered the storm of a chip crunch by holding double stock.
s1_cn: 这家供应商靠双倍备货，渡过了芯片荒的难关。
s2_en: Bad weather delayed the test fleet, so we shifted to the indoor rig.
s2_cn: 恶劣天气延误了测试车队，于是我们转到室内台架。
s3_en: We weather the cost swing with a fixed-price contract on key metals.
s3_cn: 我们用关键金属的定价合同，扛住成本波动。

s1_en: Week by week, the pilot line cut its changeover loss to almost nothing.
s1_cn: 逐周来看，试点产线把换型损失降到了几乎为零。
s2_en: We report warranty week by week so a shift never hides for long.
s2_cn: 我们按周汇报保修情况，使任何变化都藏不住。
s3_en: The launch slipped by one week, but the fix was worth the wait.
s3_cn: 上市推迟了一周，但这次整改值得等待。

s1_en: The curb weight sets the fuel economy rating.
s1_cn: 整备质量决定了燃油经济性评级。
s2_en: We cut weight with an aluminum body.
s2_cn: 我们用铝制车身减重。
s3_en: Each gram of weight affects the range.
s3_cn: 每一克重量都影响续航。

s1_en: A strong wind blew the leaves off.
s1_cn: 一阵强风吹落了树叶。
s2_en: The wind dried the wet paint.
s2_cn: 风把湿漆吹干。
s3_en: High winds delayed the crane work.
s3_cn: 大风延误了吊车作业。

cn: n. 葡萄酒；v. 款待；宴请（wine and dine）
s1_en: We wined and dined the key dealers at the launch.
s1_cn: 在发布会上，我们款待了关键经销商。
s2_en: Wining and dining alone will not close the deal.
s2_cn: 光靠款待客户是签不下单的。
s3_en: The budget for wining and dining is tight this year.
s3_cn: 今年客户招待预算很紧。

s1_en: The quality report is generated every winter.
s1_cn: 质量报告每冬天生成。
s2_en: We review supplier performance on a winter basis.
s2_cn: 我们按冬天审查供应商表现。
s3_en: The winter output exceeded our target by 5 percent.
s3_cn: 冬天产量超出目标5%。

s1_en: She is the woman for the job of turning around the unit.
s1_cn: 她是扭转该业务单元局面的不二人选。
s2_en: The conference gathered women of influence in manufacturing.
s2_cn: 这次会议汇聚了制造业中有影响力的女性。
s3_en: A sharp woman in procurement saved the quarter on steel costs.
s3_cn: 采购部一位敏锐的女性，为季度钢材成本立下功劳。

s1_en: The luxury grade uses wood trim on the dash.
s1_cn: 豪华版在仪表台上采用木纹饰板。
s2_en: We pack the parts in wood crates for export.
s2_cn: 出口零部件我们用木箱包装。
s3_en: Wood grain is matched across the door panels.
s3_cn: 木纹在门板间进行对花匹配。

s1_en: The premium seat uses a wool blend.
s1_cn: 高端座椅采用羊毛混纺。
s2_en: Wool blends resist odor in the cabin.
s2_cn: 羊毛混纺在车厢内抗异味。
s3_en: We source wool from certified mills.
s3_cn: 我们的羊毛来自认证工厂。

cn: n. 单词；话语；n. 消息；承诺
s1_en: Word of mouth from happy owners drove a third of our new orders.
s1_cn: 满意车主的口碑，带来了我们三分之一的新订单。
s2_en: The brand's word on safety is backed by every audit we pass.
s2_cn: 品牌在安全上的承诺，由我们通过的每次审计背书。
s3_en: A kind word from the supervisor lifted the night shift's morale.
s3_cn: 主管的一句暖心话，提振了夜班的士气。

cn: n. 工作；作业；v. 工作；运转；起作用
s1_en: The assembly work on Line 2 was delayed by a tooling issue.
s1_cn: 2号线的装配作业因工装问题延迟。
s2_en: Our team's work on the new model is ahead of schedule.
s2_cn: 我们团队在新车型上的工作进度超前。
s3_en: Please document all work changes in the shift log.
s3_cn: 请在交接记录中记录所有工作变更。

cn: n. 缠绕；线圈；v. 缠绕（wind 过去式）
s1_en: The motor winds the copper wire into a tight wound coil for max torque.
s1_cn: 电机把铜线绕成紧密的线圈，以获得最大扭矩。
s2_en: The wound stator passed the heat test that the old design had failed.
s2_cn: 缠绕式定子通过了旧设计没过关的耐热测试。
s3_en: A poorly wound coil overheats, so we laser-check every turn on the line.
s3_cn: 绕得差的线圈会过热，因此我们在线上用激光检查每一匝。

cn: n. 写作；文字；n. 文件；记录
s1_en: We put the change order in writing so no one recalls the spec differently.
s1_cn: 我们把变更单写成书面文件，使无人对规范记忆不一。
s2_en: Clear writing in the manual cut the service call rate by a fifth.
s2_cn: 手册里清晰的文字，把服务呼叫率降低了五分之一。
s3_en: His writing on lean flow became the plant's standard training text.
s3_cn: 他关于精益流转的著述，成了工厂的标准培训教材。

s1_en: An angle is part of geometry.
s1_cn: 角是几何的一部分。
s2_en: The worker cut the metal at a sharp angle.
s2_cn: 工人以锐角切割金属。
s3_en: We measured the angle of the slope.
s3_cn: 我们测量了斜坡的角度。

cn: n. 蚂蚁；坐立不安（have ants in one's pants）
s1_en: The sales team had ants in their pants before the bid.
s1_cn: 投标前，销售团队坐立不安。
s2_en: Don't have ants in your pants; the audit takes time.
s2_cn: 别着急，审计需要时间。
s3_en: Investors with ants in their pants sold too early.
s3_cn: 那些焦躁的投资者卖得太早了。

meanings.cn: 蚂蚁；坐立不安（have ants in one's pants）

cn: n. 苹果；同类事物（compare apples to apples 同类比较）
s1_en: Compare apples to apples when benchmarking plants.
s1_cn: 对标工厂时，要做同类对比。
s2_en: The apple of the board's eye is the new platform.
s2_cn: 董事会的掌上明珠是那个新平台。
s3_en: We keep apple-to-apple data for the quarterly review.
s3_cn: 我们为季度评审保留同类可比的数据。

meanings.cn: 苹果；同类事物（compare apples to apples 同类比较）

s1_en: The wheel arch traps mud on rough roads.
s1_cn: 轮拱在烂路上会积泥。
s2_en: We reinforce the arch to cut cabin noise.
s2_cn: 我们加固轮拱以降低车厢噪音。
s3_en: A dented wheel arch failed the final inspection.
s3_cn: 凹陷的轮拱没通过终检。

cn: n. 手臂；臂；v. 武装；启动（使待命）
s1_en: We armed the line with a second robot to hit the new takt time.
s1_cn: 我们给产线装备了第二台机器人，以达到新节拍。
s2_en: The robot arm placed the windshield in one smooth move, no manual touch.
s2_cn: 机械臂以一次平稳动作装上挡风玻璃，无需人工。
s3_en: The safety system arms only after every guard is confirmed closed.
s3_cn: 安全系统只在确认每个防护门关闭后才进入待命。

cn: n. 军队；n. 大批；团队
s1_en: An army of suppliers backed the launch, each with a clear delivery window.
s1_cn: 一大批供应商支撑了这次上市，各自都有明确的交付窗口。
s2_en: We trained an army of inspectors to cover every shift on three lines.
s2_cn: 我们培训了一大批检验员，覆盖三条产线的每个班次。
s3_en: The army of data from the line feeds the model that predicts faults.
s3_cn: 产线积累的大批数据，喂给预测故障的模型。

phrase_cn: 倾注心血的项目；心头肉
s1_en: The new venture is our baby; we have nurtured it from seed round to scale.
s1_cn: 这家新创公司是咱们的心头肉，我们从种子轮一路把它带大。
s2_en: The new plant is the baby of the group—everyone watches it closely.
s2_cn: 这家新工厂是集团的“心头肉”，人人都密切关注。
s3_en: Do not treat the intern like a baby; give real responsibility.
s3_cn: 不要把实习生当小孩对待，要给予真正的责任。

cn: n. 袋；包；v. 装袋；拿下（口语）
s1_en: The export team bagged the deal for two thousand units in one quarter.
s1_cn: 出口团队在一个季度内拿下了两千台的订单。
s2_en: We bag the trim parts to keep them clean on the way to final assembly.
s2_cn: 我们把饰件装袋，使它们在去总装途中保持洁净。
s3_en: A sealed bag on the seat marks the car as inspected and ready to ship.
s3_cn: 座椅上的封口袋，表示该车的检验已完成、可以发运。

s1_en: The wheel hub uses a sealed ball bearing.
s1_cn: 轮毂采用密封滚珠轴承。
s2_en: A failed ball bearing caused the gearbox noise.
s2_cn: 滚珠轴承失效导致了变速箱异响。
s3_en: We stock ball bearings in several sizes.
s3_cn: 我们备有数种尺寸的滚珠轴承。

s1_en: We set a price band for the new SUV.
s1_cn: 我们为这款新SUV设定了价格带。
s2_en: Sales fell outside the target band.
s2_cn: 销量落在目标区间之外。
s3_en: Each market has its own price band.
s3_cn: 每个市场都有自己的价格带。

cn: n. 盆；槽；n. 盆地；流域
s1_en: The parts dip in the wash basin before the coating line takes them.
s1_cn: 零件在进涂装线前先浸入清洗槽。
s2_en: The plant sits in a basin, so we built drainage to handle the monsoon.
s2_cn: 工厂位于盆地，因此我们建了排水以应对雨季。
s3_en: A marked basin collects the spent solvent for safe recycling.
s3_cn: 一个标识槽收集废溶剂，以便安全回收。

cn: n. 篮；筐；n. 物料筐（看板筐）
s1_en: Line-side parts baskets cut walking time for the assembly crew.
s1_cn: 线边零件筐减少了装配工人的走动时间。
s2_en: The kanban basket triggers replenishment when it runs low.
s2_cn: 看板筐在快空时触发补料。
s3_en: We sorted defective clips into the red rejection basket.
s3_cn: 我们把缺陷卡扣挑进红色不合格筐。

cn: n. 浴；浴槽；v. 浸泡；镀
s1_en: The frame takes an acid bath to strip rust before the new coating.
s1_cn: 车架在重新涂装前先过酸洗槽除锈。
s2_en: The plating bath gave the trim a finish that passed the salt-spray test.
s2_cn: 电镀槽让饰条获得通过盐雾测试的表面。
s3_en: We heat the bath to a set point so every part leaves with the same look.
s3_cn: 我们把槽液加热到设定值，使每个零件出来的外观一致。

cn: n. 床；n. 底盘；床身；v. 嵌入；安放
s1_en: The new line bedded in over two weeks and hit rate on the third shift.
s1_cn: 新产线在两周内完成磨合，第三班就达到了节拍。
s2_en: The engine bed uses a stiff frame to cut vibration into the cabin.
s2_cn: 发动机底盘采用刚性框架，以减少传入座舱的振动。
s3_en: Welds bed the bracket into the body so it never loosens on rough roads.
s3_cn: 焊缝把支架嵌入车身，使其在烂路上也不松动。

s1_en: Our agri client exports bee pollen abroad.
s1_cn: 我们的农业客户向海外出口蜂花粉。
s2_en: Bees pollinate the plants near the test farm.
s2_cn: 蜜蜂为试验田附近的植物授粉。
s3_en: We fund bee research with the farm.
s3_cn: 我们与农场合作资助蜜蜂研究。

s1_en: The line stop triggered a warning bell.
s1_cn: 产线停机触发了警示铃。
s2_en: A quality issue rang a warning bell.
s2_cn: 质量问题敲响了警钟。
s3_en: The bell alerts workers to shift change.
s3_cn: 铃声提醒工人换班。

s1_en: We picked the low-hanging berry first.
s1_cn: 我们先摘了低垂的果实。
s2_en: The low-hanging berry was the export rebate.
s2_cn: 低垂的果实就是出口退税。
s3_en: Don't ignore the low-hanging berry in sales.
s3_cn: 别忽视销售中易得的成果。

meanings.cn: 浆果；（习语）低垂的果实，易得的成果

s1_en: Early bird orders get a discount.
s1_cn: 早鸟订单享受折扣。
s2_en: Early bird buyers reserved the first batch.
s2_cn: 早鸟买家预订了首批产品。
s3_en: We reward early bird subscribers.
s3_cn: 我们奖励早鸟订阅者。

meanings.cn: 鸟；早鸟（提前下单/行动者）

cn: n. 刀片；叶片；n. 桨叶
s1_en: The turbine blade passed the heat test that proves it lasts the warranty.
s1_cn: 涡轮叶片通过了能证明其撑过保修期的耐热测试。
s2_en: A worn blade left a burr on the trim, so we swapped it before the run.
s2_cn: 磨损的刀片在饰条上留下毛刺，于是我们在开线前换掉它。
s3_en: The wiper blade was tuned for silent sweep, a small but felt detail.
s3_cn: 雨刮片被调校得静音刮扫，是个小却可感知的细节。

cn: n. 木板；董事会；v. 上（车/船/机）；入职，使就位
s1_en: We brought 20 new engineers on board.
s1_cn: 我们招入了20名新工程师。
s2_en: The board approved the budget.
s2_cn: 董事会批准了预算。
s3_en: Get all regions on board before launch.
s3_cn: 上市前要让所有区域就位。

s1_en: Suppliers and OEMs are in the same boat.
s1_cn: 供应商与主机厂同处一条船。
s2_en: We are in the same boat on this recall.
s2_cn: 这次召回我们处境相同。
s3_en: Don't rock the boat during peak season.
s3_cn: 旺季里别搅局。

meanings.cn: 小船；（习语）同处一条船；别搅局

s1_en: The bone of contention was the tooling cost, until we split it with the supplier.
s1_cn: 争议焦点是模具费，直到我们与供应商分摊才解决。
s2_en: The chassis is the bone of the vehicle, so we check it first in every audit.
s2_cn: 底盘是车辆的骨架，因此每次审计我们都先查它。
s3_en: A good safety cage protects the occupant like a shield around the bone.
s3_cn: 好的安全笼像护住骨架的盾，保护乘员。

cn: n. 书；书籍；v. 预订；登记
s1_en: She reads a book every week.
s1_cn: 她每周读一本书。
s2_en: He wrote a book on cars.
s2_cn: 他写了一本关于汽车的书。
s3_en: The book on the desk is mine.
s3_cn: 桌上的书是我的。

s1_en: The board gave the underperforming VP the boot.
s1_cn: 董事会解雇了那位业绩不佳的副总裁。
s2_en: Boot up the manufacturing execution system before the morning shift.
s2_cn: 在早班开工前，启动制造执行系统。
s3_en: New hires join a two-week boot camp on safety and quality.
s3_cn: 新员工参加为期两周的安全与质量集训。

s1_en: The coolant bottle cracked in the cold.
s1_cn: 冷却液壶在寒冷中冻裂。
s2_en: The line fills a thousand bottles an hour.
s2_cn: 产线每小时灌装一千个瓶子。
s3_en: A loose bottle jammed the conveyor.
s3_cn: 一个松脱的瓶子卡住了传送带。

cn: n. 箱；盒；v. 装箱；盒装
s1_en: The gear box was tuned for smooth shift, a key feel in the test drive.
s1_cn: 变速箱被调校得换挡平顺，这是试驾里的关键体感。
s2_en: We box the trim kit so it arrives at the dealer free of scuff marks.
s2_cn: 我们把饰件套装装箱，使其到店时没有被蹭的痕迹。
s3_en: A sealed box on the line marks the part as inspected and traceable.
s3_cn: 产线上一个封箱，标记该件已检且可追溯。

s1_en: He won the account through the old boy network, not the pitch.
s1_cn: 他靠老关系网而非路演拿下了这个客户。
s2_en: The boy wonder from R&D filed three patents before turning twenty.
s2_cn: 这位研发神童在20岁前就提交了三项专利。
s3_en: The new boy on the production line caught the defect first.
s3_cn: 生产线上的新手最先发现了这个缺陷。

cn: n. 脑；智慧；v. 谋划；动脑
s1_en: We picked the veteran's brain on the fixture that cut setup by half.
s1_cn: 我们就那套把准备时间减半的夹具，向老技师取经。
s2_en: The control unit is the brain of the line, logging every cycle in real time.
s2_cn: 控制单元是产线的大脑，实时记录每个节拍。
s3_en: Good data is only as good as the brain that reads it.
s3_cn: 好数据只有在会读它的人手里才有价值。

s1_en: The brake system testing passed all safety standards.
s1_cn: 制动系统测试通过了所有安全标准。
s2_en: We upgraded the brake calipers for the new model.
s2_cn: 我们为新车型升级了制动卡钳。
s3_en: Please inspect the brake pads during routine maintenance.
s3_cn: 请在例行维护时检查刹车片。

cn: n. 分支；部门；v. 分叉；拓展
s1_en: We branched out from sedans into EVs without building a second plant.
s1_cn: 我们在不建第二家工厂的情况下，从轿车拓展到了电动车。
s2_en: The procurement branch owned the supplier scorecard end to end.
s2_cn: 采购部门端到端负责供应商记分卡。
s3_en: A branch of the training program now serves the overseas plants.
s3_cn: 培训项目的一个分支，如今服务于海外工厂。

s1_en: We run brick-and-mortar dealerships.
s1_cn: 我们经营实体经销店。
s2_en: Online sales complement brick-and-mortar stores.
s2_cn: 线上销售补充了实体门店。
s3_en: The brick-and-mortar network covers 30 cities.
s3_cn: 实体店网络覆盖30座城市。

s1_en: Training bridges the gap for new hires.
s1_cn: 培训弥合了新员工的差距。
s2_en: We bridge the gap between R&D and plant.
s2_cn: 我们弥合研发与工厂之间的差距。
s3_en: A buffer stock bridges the gap in supply.
s3_cn: 安全库存弥合了供应缺口。

s1_en: He cleaned the car with a brush.
s1_cn: 他用刷子清洗汽车。
s2_en: The brush is made of soft hair.
s2_cn: 刷子由软毛制成。
s3_en: Use a brush to apply the glue.
s3_cn: 用刷子涂胶水。

s1_en: The coolant bucket is refilled every 2 hours during production.
s1_cn: 冷却液桶在生产期间每2小时补充。
s2_en: We use a bucket to collect oil samples for laboratory analysis.
s2_cn: 我们用桶收集油样用于实验室分析。
s3_en: A bucket of solvent is kept at each cleaning station for degreasing.
s3_cn: 每个清洁站备有一桶溶剂用于除油。

s1_en: The headlight bulb failed in cold weather.
s1_cn: 大灯灯泡在寒冷天气里失效。
s2_en: We switched to LED bulbs.
s2_cn: 我们换用了LED灯泡。
s3_en: A burnt bulb triggered a warranty claim.
s3_cn: 烧坏的灯泡引发了一起保修索赔。

s1_en: The car has a push-button start.
s1_cn: 这辆车有一键启动。
s2_en: He pushed the button on the deal.
s2_cn: 他拍板了这笔交易。
s3_en: A worn button caused a fault.
s3_cn: 磨损的按钮导致了一个故障。

s1_en: Each dealer wants a slice of the cake.
s1_cn: 每家经销商都想分得一杯羹。
s2_en: We grew our slice of the export cake.
s2_cn: 我们扩大了出口份额。
s3_en: The cake is big enough for all.
s3_cn: 这块蛋糕足够所有人分。

s1_en: The inspection camera detects surface defects on the body panels.
s1_cn: 检测相机检测车身面板的表面缺陷。
s2_en: We installed a camera system on the assembly line for quality monitoring.
s2_cn: 我们在装配线上安装了相机系统用于质量监控。
s3_en: The camera resolution must be 12 megapixels for reliable defect detection.
s3_cn: 相机分辨率必须达到1200万像素以确保可靠的缺陷检测。

cn: n. 卡片；n. 名片；n. 门禁卡；采购卡
s1_en: He exchanged business cards after closing the distribution deal.
s1_cn: 他签下经销协议后交换了名片。
s2_en: The access card grants entry only to authorized zones of the plant.
s2_cn: 门禁卡只放行工厂的授权区域。
s3_en: The procurement card simplifies small, frequent purchases.
s3_cn: 采购卡简化了小额高频采购。

cn: n. 手推车；购物车（shopping cart）
s1_en: The shopping cart drove online sales.
s1_cn: 购物车拉动了线上销售。
s2_en: An empty cart means a lost buyer.
s2_cn: 空购物车意味着流失的买家。
s3_en: We track carts at checkout.
s3_cn: 我们追踪结算环节的购物车。

s1_en: The quote is carriage paid to port.
s1_cn: 报价含运至港口的运费。
s2_en: Carriage adds 5% to the cost.
s2_cn: 运费使成本增加5%。
s3_en: We negotiate carriage with the carrier.
s3_cn: 我们与承运商洽谈运费。

phrase_en: let the cat out of the bag
s1_en: He let the cat out of the bag on pricing.
s1_cn: 他走漏了定价的风声。
s2_en: Don't let the cat out of the bag before launch.
s2_cn: 上市前别走漏风声。
s3_en: A leak let the cat out of the bag.
s3_cn: 一次泄露走漏了消息。

cn: n. 链；n. 供应链；v. 用链锁；连锁
s1_en: The supply chain held through the crunch because we built second sources.
s1_cn: 供应链在紧缺中挺住了，因为我们建了第二货源。
s2_en: A weak link in the chain let a bad seal reach the line, so we added a check.
s2_cn: 链条上的薄弱环节让不良密封件上了线，于是我们加了检查。
s3_en: We chained the stations so a fault upstream stops the whole cell safely.
s3_cn: 我们把工位连锁，使上游故障能安全停下整个单元。

s1_en: The big cheese approved the budget at the last minute.
s1_cn: 那位大老板在最后一刻批准了预算。
s2_en: Our cheese import line meets strict cold-chain standards.
s2_cn: 我们的奶酪进口线符合严格的冷链标准。
s3_en: He is the big cheese in charge of regional procurement.
s3_cn: 他是负责区域采购的头号人物。

cn: n. 胸；胸腔；n. 工具箱
s1_en: The maintenance tech rolled the tool chest to the stalled press.
s1_cn: 维修技师把工具箱推到停机的压机旁。
s2_en: A first-aid kit in the chest protects workers from minor injuries.
s2_cn: 工具箱里的急救包防护工人的小伤。
s3_en: He felt a tight chest after lifting the heavy crate—a reminder to use the trolley.
s3_cn: 搬重箱后他胸口发紧，提醒该用推车。

s1_en: The team kept its chin up through the recall and came back stronger.
s1_cn: 团队在召回中保持信心，之后变得更强。
s2_en: The crash test loads the chin of the dummy to grade neck protection.
s2_cn: 碰撞测试对假人下颌施载，以评定颈部保护等级。
s3_en: A chin bar on the frame guides the panel into the weld jig square.
s3_cn: 框架上的定位块引导板材方正进入焊接夹具。

phrase_en: as poor as a church mouse
s1_en: After the failed bet, the unit was as poor as a church mouse.
s1_cn: 那次失败的押注后，该业务单元一贫如洗。
s2_en: The old church on the site was repurposed as the training center.
s2_cn: 场地上的老教堂被改造成了培训中心。
s3_en: Community trust is the church we build our brand on.
s3_cn: 社区信任是我们建立品牌的基石。

cn: n. 圆；圈子；v. 绕圈；圈出
s1_en: We circled back to the dealer after the fix and won the order.
s1_cn: 整改后我们回访经销商，拿下了订单。
s2_en: The robot circles the seam once to lay a continuous, even weld.
s2_cn: 机器人绕缝一圈，焊出连续均匀的焊缝。
s3_en: The inner circle of engineers owned the root-cause close-out.
s3_cn: 工程师核心小组负责根因的关闭。

s1_en: The cycle clock tracks the takt time for each assembly station.
s1_cn: 循环时钟追踪每个装配工位的节拍时间。
s2_en: We synchronize the clock across all production lines for shift coordination.
s2_cn: 我们同步所有产线的时钟以协调班次。
s3_en: The clock display shows the remaining time for the current production order.
s3_cn: 时钟显示屏显示当前生产订单的剩余时间。

cn: n. 云；n. 云系统（云端）；v. 阴云密布
s1_en: The cloud-based dashboard let managers see three plants on one screen.
s1_cn: 云端看板让管理者在一块屏上看到三家工厂。
s2_en: A dark cloud of a chip short loomed, so we locked stock early.
s2_cn: 芯片短缺的阴云逼近，于是我们早早锁定了库存。
s3_en: Field data flows to the cloud nightly, so the model trains while we sleep.
s3_cn: 现场数据每晚流向云端，模型在我们休息时持续训练。

s1_en: The new car got a coat of polish before the show.
s1_cn: 这辆新车在展示前打了一层抛光。
s2_en: Rust formed where the coat was scratched off.
s2_cn: 涂层被刮掉的地方生了锈。
s3_en: He put on his coat before going out to the cold lot.
s3_cn: 他穿上外套才去外面寒冷的停车场。

s1_en: Blue-collar workers run the line.
s1_cn: 蓝领工人操作产线。
s2_en: We train blue-collar teams.
s2_cn: 我们培训蓝领团队。
s3_en: Blue-collar pay rose with output.
s3_cn: 蓝领工资随产量上升。

cn: n. 梳子；排针；v. 梳理；搜遍
s1_en: The analyst combed through the warranty data to find the root cause.
s1_cn: 分析师梳理保修数据以找到根因。
s2_en: The connector uses a comb of pins for a secure board link.
s2_cn: 连接器用一排针脚实现稳固的板间连接。
s3_en: We combed the supplier list and dropped the low-score vendors.
s3_cn: 我们梳理供应商名单，剔除了低分者。

s1_en: Power cord routing in the engine bay follows the harness design rule.
s1_cn: 发动机舱的电源线布线遵循线束设计规则。
s2_en: The cord on the charging cable must meet the bending radius specification.
s2_cn: 充电线缆的线材必须满足弯曲半径规格。
s3_en: We test cord flexibility at extreme temperatures for EV charging systems.
s3_cn: 我们测试EV充电系统线缆在极端温度下的柔韧性。

s1_en: We buy cow hides for the seat covers.
s1_cn: 我们采购牛皮做座椅套。
s2_en: A cow farm supplies our leather.
s2_cn: 牧场为我们供应皮革。
s3_en: Cow leather beats synthetic in wear tests.
s3_cn: 耐磨测试里牛皮胜过合成革。

meanings.cn: 奶牛；母牛；牛皮；现金牛（cash cow）

s1_en: Public speaking is not everyone's cup of tea, but leaders must do it.
s1_cn: 公开演讲并非每个人都喜欢，但领导者必须胜任。
s2_en: The sponsor lifted the championship cup at the awards dinner.
s2_cn: 赞助商在颁奖晚宴上举起了冠军奖杯。
s3_en: The client meeting closed over a cup of coffee that turned into a contract.
s3_cn: 客户会谈在一杯咖啡的工夫里，谈成了一份合同。

cn: n. 帘；幕；v. 装帘；遮蔽
s1_en: Behind the curtain, a small team tuned the launch plan week by week.
s1_cn: 幕后，一个小团队逐周打磨上市计划。
s2_en: The paint booth curtain keeps overspray from reaching the next car.
s2_cn: 喷漆房的帘子防止飞漆落到下一辆车。
s3_en: We lift the curtain on cost by sharing the bill of materials with buyers.
s3_cn: 我们通过向采购公开物料清单，揭开成本的面纱。

cn: n. 软垫；缓冲；v. 缓冲；缓解
s1_en: The cash cushion let the plant ride out the demand dip without layoffs.
s1_cn: 现金缓冲让工厂在不裁员的情况下挺过需求下滑。
s2_en: The seat cushion was tuned for an eight-hour drive, not a show pose.
s2_cn: 座椅软垫按八小时长途调校，而非只为展示姿态。
s3_en: A second source cushioned the blow when the first supplier failed audit.
s3_cn: 在第一家供应商审计失败之际，第二货源缓冲了冲击。

s1_en: That model was a dog in the market.
s1_cn: 那款车型在市场上滞销。
s2_en: We killed the dog after weak sales.
s2_cn: 销量疲软后我们砍掉了这款滞销品。
s3_en: Every line has a dog sometimes.
s3_cn: 每条产品线偶尔都会有滞销货。

s1_en: The joint venture opened the door to the Southeast Asian market.
s1_cn: 这家合资企业为东南亚市场打开了大门。
s2_en: We offer door-to-door logistics for key clients.
s2_cn: 我们为重要客户提供门到门的物流服务。
s3_en: The failed audit closed the door on the supplier's certification.
s3_cn: 这次失败的审计，让该供应商失去了认证资格。

cn: n. 排水口；地漏；排水管；v. 排出（液体）；排空
s1_en: The maintenance team cleared the floor drain after the coolant spill.
s1_cn: 冷却液泄漏后，维修班组清理了车间地漏。
s2_en: A blocked drain slowed the wash bay and idled two shifts.
s2_cn: 一处堵塞的排水口拖慢了清洗区，让两个班次停了工。
s3_en: We inspect every drain monthly to keep the workshop flood-free.
s3_cn: 我们每月检查每个排水口，确保车间不发生积水。

s1_en: He put the file in the drawer.
s1_cn: 他把文件放进抽屉。
s2_en: The drawer is stuck.
s2_cn: 抽屉卡住了。
s3_en: Lock the drawer at night.
s3_cn: 晚上锁好抽屉。

cn: n. 连衣裙；服装；v. 穿衣；着装（dress code 着装规范）
s1_en: The summit enforced a strict business dress code.
s1_cn: 这次峰会实行了严格的商务着装规范。
s2_en: She dressed the part for the investor pitch and won confidence.
s2_cn: 她为投资人路演着装得体，赢得了信任。
s3_en: Our regional offices adapt the dress code to local business culture.
s3_cn: 我们的区域办公室根据当地商务文化调整着装规范。

meanings.cn: 穿衣；着装（dress code 着装规范）

s1_en: A drop of water fell on the glass.
s1_cn: 一滴水落在玻璃上。
s2_en: Add a drop of oil to the hinge.
s2_cn: 往铰链上加一滴油。
s3_en: The drop slid down the window.
s3_cn: 水滴顺着窗户滑下。

cn: n. 耳朵；倾听（lend an ear）
s1_en: Good leaders lend an ear to frontline feedback.
s1_cn: 优秀的领导者会倾听一线反馈。
s2_en: We cannot turn a deaf ear to repeated quality complaints from clients.
s2_cn: 我们不能对客户反复的质量投诉充耳不闻。
s3_en: News of the export order was music to the team's ears.
s3_cn: 拿到出口订单的消息，对团队来说真是佳音。

cn: n. 鸡蛋；孤注一掷（all eggs in one basket）；次品（rotten egg）
phrase_en: put all eggs in one basket
phrase_cn: 孤注一掷；过度依赖单一
s1_en: Do not put all your eggs in one supplier's basket.
s1_cn: 不要把所有鸡蛋放在同一个供应商的篮子里（即不要过度依赖单一供应商）。
s2_en: We rejected the whole carton after finding one rotten egg in the shipment.
s2_cn: 我们在货品中发现一颗臭蛋后，整箱拒收。
s3_en: Spreading the budget across regions avoids the risk of one broken egg sinking the plan.
s3_cn: 把预算分散到多个区域，免得单一环节出问题拖垮全局。

meanings.cn: 鸡蛋；孤注一掷（all eggs in one basket）；次品（rotten egg）

s1_en: The engine performance test results exceeded our targets.
s1_cn: 发动机性能测试结果超出目标。
s2_en: We are developing a new turbocharged engine for better efficiency.
s2_cn: 我们正在开发新型涡轮增压发动机以提高效率。
s3_en: The engine supplier delivered the first batch of prototypes.
s3_cn: 发动机供应商交付了首批样件。

cn: n. 眼睛；关注（keep an eye on）
phrase_en: keep an eye on the budget
s1_en: The controller keeps a close eye on monthly expenditures.
s1_cn: 财务总监密切留意每月支出。
s2_en: Engineers are eyeing the test data from the first prototype.
s2_cn: 工程师们正密切关注首款原型车的测试数据。
s3_en: A recall keeps the brand in the public eye for the wrong reason.
s3_cn: 一次召回会让品牌因负面原因受到公众关注。

meanings.cn: 眼睛；关注（keep an eye on）

cn: n. 脸；面；v. 面对；朝向
s1_en: We faced a tough challenge when the key press broke two weeks out.
s1_cn: 在关键压机提前两周坏掉时，我们面对了一个严峻挑战。
s2_en: The face of the grille signals the brand before a word is read.
s2_cn: 格栅的面孔在读出任何字之前就传递了品牌。
s3_en: She faced the audit board and closed every finding with data.
s3_cn: 她直面审计委员会，用数据关闭了每一项发现。

cn: n. 农场；垂直农场（vertical farm）；v. 外包（farm out）
s1_en: We farmed out the testing to a certified lab.
s1_cn: 我们把测试外包给了一家认证实验室。
s2_en: The vertical farm supplies fresh herbs to the campus canteen.
s2_cn: 这座立体农场为园区食堂供应新鲜香草。
s3_en: Do not farm out core engineering to unknown vendors.
s3_cn: 不要把核心工程外包给不知名的供应商。

cn: n. 羽毛；羽状；v. 轻收（油门）
s1_en: The test driver feathered the throttle to keep traction on the wet track.
s1_cn: 试车手平稳收油门，以在湿滑赛道保持抓地。
s2_en: A feather-light touch on the screen avoids mis-clicks during the demo.
s2_cn: 演示时羽毛般轻触屏幕，避免误点。
s3_en: The stylist added a feather detail to the show car's trim.
s3_cn: 造型师在展车饰条上加了羽毛细节。

cn: n. 手指；v. 指出；责备
s1_en: We point a finger at the process, not the person, when a defect shows up.
s1_cn: 出现缺陷时，我们指向流程而非个人。
s2_en: The robot's finger places the tiny clip without a scratch.
s2_cn: 机器人的"手指"无伤地放好那个小卡子。
s3_en: A light finger on the screen confirms the check, no pen, no paper.
s3_cn: 在屏幕上轻点一下即确认检查，无需笔和纸。

cn: n. 鱼；大人物（a big fish）；v. 寻找（fish for）
s1_en: We spent a year fishing for the right logistics partner.
s1_cn: 我们花了一年时间，寻找合适的物流合作伙伴。
s2_en: It is time to fish or cut bait on the stalled joint venture.
s2_cn: 对那个停滞的合资项目，是时候要么推进、要么放弃了。
s3_en: The anchor client was the biggest fish we landed this quarter.
s3_cn: 那家锚定客户是我们本季度拿下的头号大客户。

cn: n. 旗帜；警示标志；v. 标记；提出警示
s1_en: The line inspector raised a flag when the weld looked off.
s1_cn: 当焊缝看起来有问题时，线检员提出了质量警示。
s2_en: A red flag on the audit report stopped the shipment.
s2_cn: 审计报告上的一处红色警示叫停了这批发货。
s3_en: We planted the company flag at the new overseas plant.
s3_cn: 我们在新建的海外工厂升起了公司旗帜。

cn: n. 地板；楼层；车间（factory floor）；底价（floor price）；发言（take the floor）
s1_en: The CFO took the floor to explain the quarterly results.
s1_cn: 首席财务官起身发言，解释季度业绩。
s2_en: The floor price was set to protect the brand's positioning.
s2_cn: 最低限价被设定为保护品牌定位。
s3_en: Morale on the factory floor improved after the shift change.
s3_cn: 换班后，车间一线的士气有所提升。

meanings.cn: 地板；楼层；车间（factory floor）；底价（floor price）；发言（take the floor）

cn: n. 苍蝇；v. 飞；飞行；驾驶（飞机）

s1_cn: 食堂里出现苍蝇违反食品安全规定，会被罚款。
s2_en: The pest-control team set traps to keep flies out of the workshop.
s2_cn: 虫害防控小组布设诱捕，防止苍蝇进入车间。

s3_cn: 喷漆房里的一只苍蝇就能毁掉整块车身面板。

s1_cn: 区域办事处将承担客户晚宴的费用。

s2_cn: 新任CEO徒步走访车间，清晰看到了瓶颈所在。

s3_cn: 他通过一次战略实习，敲开了这个行业的大门。

s2_cn: 他放下餐叉，赶去参加线边会议。
s3_en: We packed a fork and a spoon for the field service trip.
s3_cn: 我们为现场服务出差打包了餐叉和勺子。

s1_cn: 家禽养殖行业受到了运输罢工的重创。

s2_cn: 新的冷链保护家禽从农场到货架的品质。
s3_en: The plan was neither fowl nor good fish—it satisfied no stakeholder.
s3_cn: 这个方案不伦不类，没有让任何利益相关方满意。

s1_en: The vehicle frame was redesigned for better crash performance.
s1_cn: 车架经过重新设计以提升碰撞表现。
s2_en: We weld the frame on the robotic assembly line.
s2_cn: 我们在机器人装配线上焊接车架。
s3_en: The frame material was changed to high-strength steel.
s3_cn: 车架材料改为高强度钢。

s1_cn: 供应商在交货时间上误导了我们。

s2_cn: 这不是一次普通的延误，它影响了整条产线。
s3_en: We tend the partnership like a garden to keep it productive.
s3_cn: 我们像打理花园一样经营这段合作关系，使其持续产出。

s1_cn: 首席执行官的得力女助手协调整个董事会日程。
s2_en: The girl led the digital rollout ahead of schedule.
s2_cn: 这位年轻女性提前完成了数字化推广。
s3_en: We mentor talented girls from engineering schools each summer.
s3_cn: 每年夏天，我们为工程学院的优秀女生提供导师辅导。

s1_en: Every operator wears a cut-resistant glove at the stamping press.
s1_cn: 每位操作工在冲压机前都戴防切割手套。

s2_cn: 这款合格手套通过了冷库作业测试。
s3_en: We handed out a fresh glove to each new hire on day one.
s3_cn: 入职第一天，我们给每位新员工发了一副新手套。

s1_en: The goat on the test farm helps clear the roadside brush.
s1_cn: 试验场上的山羊帮忙清理路旁灌木。

s2_cn: 试验期间，一只山羊溜上了试车场跑道。
s3_en: The goat ate grass beside the old farm building.
s3_cn: 那只山羊在旧农舍旁吃草。

cn: n. 焊枪；n. 喷枪；n. 注脂枪

s1_cn: 机器人焊枪以稳定熔深走焊。

s2_cn: 喷枪每次换色前须校准。

s3_cn: 他捏下润滑脂枪，为输送链关节加油。

cn: n. 头发；n. 极细微（口语）；v. 精确调整

s1_cn: 我们在规范上抠细节，使零件每次都一次装配合格。

s2_cn: 一道发丝般的缝隙渗了水，于是我们收紧了车门密封公差。
s3_en: The painter's eye caught a hair of color shift the meter missed.
s3_cn: 喷漆工的肉眼发现了仪器没抓到的细微色差。

s1_cn: 我们用一个周末敲定了合同，使产线得以开工。

s2_cn: 压机一击把板坯锤成形状，无需二次。
s3_en: The team hammered out a plan that cut the launch risk in half.
s3_cn: 团队苦战敲出一个把上市风险减半的计划。

cn: n. 手；第一手的（first-hand）；v. 移交（hand over）

s2_cn: 进入该区域前，我们需要第一手市场数据。
s3_en: On the one hand the cost is high; on the other hand the quality justifies it.
s3_cn: 一方面成本较高，另一方面质量对得起这个价格。

cn: n. 帽子；职责（wear many hats 身兼多职）

s1_cn: 在初创公司，你常身兼多职，从销售到运营。

s2_cn: 在董事会批准前，对重组计划要保密。
s3_en: He went to the bank hat in hand to request bridge financing.
s3_cn: 他谦卑地前往银行，请求过桥融资。

meanings.cn: 帽子；职责（wear many hats 身兼多职）

cn: n. 头；v. 领导；主管（head a division）

s1_cn: 她领导新能源汽车事业部。

s2_cn: 我们的原型在效率上远超竞品车型。
s3_en: The board asked him to head the task force on cost reduction.
s3_cn: 董事会要求他牵头负责降本专项小组。

s1_cn: 本质上，这个项目是建立信任，而非只冲产量。
s2_en: The heart of the plant is the weld shop, where quality is set.
s2_cn: 工厂的核心是焊装车间，质量在那里被定下。
s3_en: We take the owner's voice to heart in every design review.
s3_cn: 我们在每次设计评审中都把车主的声音放在心上。

cn: n. 钩；吊钩；n. 接口钩子（hook）；v. 钩住；连接

s1_cn: 吊钩把发动机缸体吊到测试区。

s2_cn: 该 API 暴露一个钩子，供 MES 拉取生产状态。

s3_cn: 我们把挂车钩上牵引车，移到暂存区。

s1_cn: 原型车驶出大门时，汽车喇叭响了两声。

s2_cn: 喇叭声音微弱，导致整车终检不合格。
s3_en: We test every horn before it ships to the assembly line.
s3_cn: 每个喇叭在发往装配线前都要经过测试。

s1_cn: 我们用轻卡底盘改装出运马拖车，面向农场市场。

s2_cn: 在乡村发布活动的演示场外，站着一匹马。
