s3_cn: 试车场与隔壁的养马场共用一道围栏。

s1_en: The CFO handed him a hospital pass: fix the audit by Friday.
s1_cn: 首席财务官交给他一个棘手任务：周五前搞定审计。
s2_en: The injured worker was taken to the hospital by ambulance.
s2_cn: 受伤员工由救护车送往医院。
s3_en: Prevention is cheaper than a hospital bill for a workplace accident.
s3_cn: 预防比工伤后的医院账单便宜得多。

s1_en: The first round of coffee was on the house at the partner event.
s1_cn: 在合作伙伴活动上，第一轮咖啡由主办方免费提供。
s2_en: The keynote brought the house down with a bold vision.
s2_cn: 主题演讲以宏大的愿景赢得了满堂彩。
s3_en: Our house view on EV demand remains strongly positive.
s3_cn: 我们对电动汽车需求的内部研判依然非常乐观。

s1_en: The joint venture became an island of stability amid market turmoil.
s1_cn: 这家合资企业在市场动荡中成了稳定的孤岛。
s2_en: We built the assembly plant on a coastal island to cut logistics cost.
s2_cn: 我们把装配厂建在沿海小岛上，以削减物流成本。
s3_en: No company is an island; our supply chain depends on global partners.
s3_cn: 没有企业是孤岛，我们的供应链依赖全球伙伴。

cn: n. 珠宝；n. 珍品；亮点；v. 镶嵌
s1_en: The new battery line is the jewel in the crown of the plant upgrade.
s1_cn: 新电池产线是这家工厂升级中最亮眼的部分。
s2_en: The show car's jewel is a console finished by hand, not by robot.
s2_cn: 展车的点睛之笔是一块手工而非机器人完成的饰板。
s3_en: We treat each patent as a jewel, logged and protected with care.
s3_cn: 我们把每项专利当作珍宝，仔细记录与保护。

s1_en: The workshop kettle boiled during the morning break.
s1_cn: 上午休息时，车间的水壶烧开了。
s2_en: He filled the kettle before the night shift started.
s2_cn: 夜班开始前，他把水壶灌满了。
s3_en: A broken kettle in the rest area slowed the tea round.
s3_cn: 休息区一只坏掉的水壶拖慢了泡茶的顺序。

cn: n. 钥匙；n. 关键；要诀；v. 键入；锁定
s1_en: The key to on-time launch was a frozen spec and a clear owner.
s1_cn: 准时上市的关键，是冻结的规范和明确的负责人。
s2_en: We keyed the part number into the system so the line pulled the right build.
s2_cn: 我们把零件号键入系统，使产线调出正确的制造指令。
s3_en: Trust is the key that opens a long partnership with the supplier.
s3_cn: 信任是开启与供应商长期合作的关键。

s1_en: Shop-floor knee protection cuts strain for workers who kneel often.
s1_cn: 车间护膝减轻了常跪员工的劳损。
s2_en: He took a knee injury from repeated squatting at the line.
s2_cn: 他因产线反复深蹲伤了膝盖。
s3_en: Adjust the seat so your knee bends at a safe angle while driving.
s3_cn: 调整座椅，让驾驶时膝盖弯成安全角度。

s1_en: The packing line keeps a utility knife at every station.
s1_cn: 包装线每个工位都备有一把美工刀。
s2_en: He cut the strap with a knife and opened the parts carton.
s2_cn: 他用刀割断捆带，打开了零部件纸箱。
s3_en: The safety knife has a blade that retracts when released.
s3_cn: 这把安全刀的刀刃在松手后会回缩。

cn: n. 结；n. 难题；症结；v. 打结；系紧
s1_en: We tied the knot on the joint venture after a year of talks.
s1_cn: 在一年谈判后，我们达成了合资协议。
s2_en: The knot in the supply plan was one single sourced chip, now dual-sourced.
s2_cn: 供应计划的症结是那颗单一货源的芯片，如今已双货源。
s3_en: The robot ties the knot on the harness wrap so it never comes loose.
s3_cn: 机器人系紧线束包覆的结，使其永不开脱。

cn: n. 叶；n. 页（书页）；v. 翻阅；翻页
s1_en: We leafed through three years of logs to find the true root cause.
s1_cn: 我们翻阅了三年的日志，找出真正的根因。
s2_en: A leaf spring in the seat keeps the ride calm over cobblestones.
s2_cn: 座椅里的片簧，在卵石路上仍保持平稳。
s3_en: The manual's leaf marks the step where most errors used to happen.
s3_cn: 手册里折起的页，正是过去最常出错的那一步。

cn: n. 腿；n. 一段（行程/赛程）
s1_en: The last leg of the launch was the dealer training, done in one week.
s1_cn: 上市的最后一程是经销商培训，在一周内完成。
s2_en: The robot leg holds the door while the welder seals the seam.
s2_cn: 机器人的"腿"扶住车门，焊接机封住焊缝。
s3_en: We paced each leg of the rollout so no plant starved for parts.
s3_cn: 我们为铺开的每一程定好节奏，使没有工厂缺件。

s1_en: The design team reuses parts from the component library.
s1_cn: 设计团队复用零部件库中的部件。
s2_en: Our libraries hold ten years of validated engineering drawings.
s2_cn: 我们的图库保存了十年经过验证的工程图纸。
s3_en: The training library added a new welding course this quarter.
s3_cn: 培训资料库本季度新增了一门焊接课程。

cn: n. 线；线条；n. 生产线；流水线；n. 队伍；行列
s1_en: The assembly line produces one vehicle every 60 seconds.
s1_cn: 装配线每60秒生产一辆车。
s2_en: We added a new line for electric vehicle production.
s2_cn: 我们新增了一条电动汽车生产线。
s3_en: Line 3 was stopped for preventive maintenance.
s3_cn: 3号线因预防性维护停线。

s1_en: The new platform was on the lips of every dealer after the keynote.
s1_cn: 新平台在主题演讲后成了每个经销商的热议。
s2_en: The lip of the panel sits flush so no edge catches a finger.
s2_cn: 板材的边缘齐平，不会被手指勾到。
s3_en: A tight lip on cost kept the margin safe through the price war.
s3_cn: 对成本的严守，让毛利在价格战中保住了。

s1_en: We locked in the price with a quarterly hedge on key metals.
s1_cn: 我们用关键金属的季度套保锁定了价格。
s2_en: The torque gun locks each bolt to the spec, no guess, no rework.
s2_cn: 扭矩枪把每个螺栓锁到规范值，不靠猜、不返工。
s3_en: The door lock passed a hundred thousand cycles in the durability rig.
s3_cn: 门锁在耐久台架上通过了十万次循环。

cn: n. 地图；图；v. 绘制；梳理
s1_en: We mapped out the supplier risk so no single point could stop the line.
s1_cn: 我们梳理了供应商风险，使没有任何单点能停掉产线。
s2_en: The value-stream map showed the wait, not the work, was the real cost.
s2_cn: 价值流图显示，真正的成本在等待而非作业。
s3_en: The navigation map updates live so the test fleet never misses a turn.
s3_cn: 导航地图实时更新，使测试车队从不错过路口。

cn: n. 比赛；对手；v. 匹配；比得上
s1_en: The new seal matched with the old housing, so no redesign was needed.
s1_cn: 新密封件与旧壳体匹配，因此无需重新设计。
s2_en: No rival could match our lead time, which won the fleet order.
s2_cn: 没有对手比得上我们的前置期，这赢下了大客户订单。
s3_en: The color match across parts passed the master sample on the first try.
s3_cn: 零件间的颜色匹配一次就通过了封样。

s1_en: The team adopted a toy monkey as the mascot for station one.
s1_cn: 团队把一只玩具猴定为1号工位的吉祥物。
s2_en: A monkey swung across the power line near the rural test track.
s2_cn: 乡村试车道附近，一只猴子荡过电线。
s3_en: We filmed the monkey at the supplier's training base for the safety video.
s3_cn: 我们在供应商培训基地拍下那只猴子，用于安全视频。

s1_en: A line stop here is once in a blue moon, because we watch every signal.
s1_cn: 这里的停线极少发生，因为我们盯紧每个信号。
s2_en: The test ran under a full moon to prove the night-vision camera.
s2_cn: 测试在满月下进行，以验证夜视摄像头。
s3_en: The new model launched once in a blue moon, so we made it count.
s3_cn: 新车型极少上市，因此我们让它物有所值。

cn: n. 嘴；口；v. 说出；装口
s1_en: We heard the spec change from the horse's mouth, not via a rumor.
s1_cn: 我们是从第一手而非小道消息听到规范变更的。
s2_en: The mouth of the intake was tuned to breathe for more low-end torque.
s2_cn: 进气口被调校得更"会呼吸"，以获得更多低扭。
s3_en: Keep it close to the chest until the owner speaks it from the mouth.
s3_cn: 在负责人亲自官宣前，先严加保密。

cn: n. 肌肉；n. 人力；实力
s1_en: Repeated practice builds muscle memory for the standard torque sequence.
s1_cn: 反复练习对标准扭矩顺序形成肌肉记忆。
s2_en: The new market entry needs the muscle of the whole sales network.
s2_cn: 新市场进入需要整个销售网络的实力支撑。
s3_en: Manual handling relies on back and leg muscle, not the arms alone.
s3_cn: 人工搬运靠腰背和腿部肌肉，而非只靠手臂。

s1_en: We nailed down the tooling cost before signing the supplier contract.
s1_cn: 我们在签供应商合同前敲定了模具费。
s2_en: The robot nails the clip in one shot, no missed press.
s2_cn: 机器人一击钉牢卡子，没有漏压。
s3_en: A loose nail in the crate let the part rattle, so we added a check.
s3_cn: 板条箱里的一颗松钉让零件咯吱响，于是我们加了检查。

cn: n. 颈；脖子；n. （neck and neck）势均力敌
s1_en: Two suppliers finished neck and neck on quality, so cost finally broke the tie.
s1_cn: 两家供应商质量不分伯仲，最终由成本定胜负。
s2_en: He craned his neck to read the top-line KPI on the board across the shop.
s2_cn: 他伸长脖子去看车间对面看板上的顶层 KPI。
s3_en: Adjust the seat to protect your neck during long drives between plants.
s3_cn: 在工厂间长途驾驶时调整座椅，保护颈部。

s1_en: The worker used a needle to stitch the torn seat cover.
s1_cn: 工人用针缝补破损的座椅套。
s2_en: A sewing machine needle broke during the upholstery work.
s2_cn: 在内饰作业中缝纫机针断了。
s3_en: She threaded the needle carefully to mend the glove.
s3_cn: 她小心穿针来缝补手套。

cn: n. 神经；n. 胆量；勇气
s1_en: The junior got up the nerve to flag a spec error, and saved a recall.
s1_cn: 那位初级工程师鼓起勇气标出一个规范错误，避免了一次召回。
s2_en: The test pushes the brake to the nerve of its limit, then a bit more.
s2_cn: 测试把刹车逼到极限边缘，再多一点。
s3_en: It takes nerve to stop the line in front of the daily target.
s3_cn: 在日目标面前停线，需要勇气。

cn: n. 网；n. 净利；净额；adj. 净的（net profit）
s1_en: The new pricing model lifted net profit by eight percent despite flat volume.
s1_cn: 尽管销量持平，新定价模型仍把净利润提升了百分之八。
s2_en: Cross-training operators builds a safety net when key staff are on leave.
s2_cn: 对操作员交叉培训，能在骨干休假时形成保障网。
s3_en: After returns and discounts, the net margin told the board the true story.
s3_cn: 扣除退货与折扣后，净利率向董事会说明了真实情况。

cn: n. 鼻子；直觉（follow one's nose）
s1_en: The veteran buyer followed his nose and avoided a risky supplier.
s1_cn: 这位资深采购凭直觉避开了一家高风险供应商。
s2_en: Some executives turn their noses up at low-margin markets.
s2_cn: 一些高管对低利润市场不屑一顾。
s3_en: The audit team nosed around the subsidiary for two weeks.
s3_cn: 审计团队在子公司细致查访了两周。

s1_en: The chassis uses a lock nut that resists vibration loosening.
s1_cn: 底盘采用能抗振松脱的锁紧螺母。
s2_en: A loose nut on the bracket triggered a line-side alert.
s2_cn: 支架上一个松动的螺母触发了线边报警。
s3_en: We torque every nut to the spec before the axle leaves the cell.
s3_cn: 车桥下线前，我们按规范给每个螺母打扭矩。

s1_en: We moved the back office to a lower-cost city.
s1_cn: 我们把后台职能迁到了成本更低的城市。
s2_en: The front office approved the pricing change within a day.
s2_cn: 决策层在一天内批准了调价。
s3_en: She held office as CFO during the toughest years.
s3_cn: 她在最艰难的几年里担任首席财务官一职。

s1_en: We squeezed the orange on the legacy product before retiring it.
s1_cn: 我们在淘汰这款老产品前，充分榨取了它的价值。
s2_en: The citrus supply contract locked in orange prices for the year.
s2_cn: 柑橘类供应合同锁定了全年的橙子价格。
s3_en: The brand's signature orange gives instant shelf recognition.
s3_cn: 该品牌标志性的橙色，让其在货架上瞬间被认出。

s1_en: The body shells cure in the oven before final paint.
s1_cn: 车身在最终喷漆前于固化炉中烘烤。
s2_en: A sensor fault dropped the oven temperature below the set point.
s2_cn: 传感器故障让炉温跌到了设定值以下。
s3_en: We log the oven cycle for each batch to trace quality.
s3_cn: 我们为每批次记录固化炉周期以便追溯质量。

cn: n. 包裹；v. 打包；分配
s1_en: We parcelled out the training so each plant owns its own cohort.
s1_cn: 我们把培训分派下去，使每家工厂负责自己的批次。
s2_en: The parcel reached the dealer with the trim kit intact and on time.
s2_cn: 包裹里的饰件完好且准时到达经销商。
s3_en: Tasks were parcelled to the right skill, not just to the nearest hand.
s3_cn: 任务按技能而非就近分派给合适的人。

s1_en: He wrote with a fountain pen.
s1_cn: 他用钢笔写字。
s2_en: The pen is out of ink.
s2_cn: 这支钢笔没墨了。
s3_en: Please sign with this pen.
s3_cn: 请用这支笔签字。

cn: n. 铅笔；v. 暂定；草拟
s1_en: We pencilled in the launch for Q3, then froze it once the line was ready.
s1_cn: 我们先把上市暂定在三季度，产线就绪后便冻结。
s2_en: The engineer pencilled the change on the drawing before the formal rev.
s2_cn: 工程师在正式升版前，先在图纸上草拟了变更。
s3_en: A pencil mark on the sample shows the trim line the painter must hit.
s3_cn: 样品上的铅笔线，标出喷漆工必须对齐的饰条边界。

cn: n. 图片；情况；v. 描绘；想象
s1_en: Once the data rolled in, the board got the picture and funded the fix.
s1_cn: 数据一出，董事会就看清全貌并注资整改。
s2_en: The picture of the line on the dashboard shows live status at a glance.
s2_cn: 看板上的产线图，一眼就能看到实时状态。
s3_en: Let me picture the flow: part in, weld, paint, assemble, ship.
s3_cn: 让我梳理一下流程：上件、焊、涂、装、发运。

s1_en: The farm pig wandered near the logistics yard fence.
s1_cn: 农场里的猪溜到了物流场围栏附近。
s2_en: A pig mascot led the children's tour of the visitor center.
s2_cn: 一只小猪吉祥物带领孩子们参观了访客中心。
s3_en: We spotted the pig at the green-field site during the walkthrough.
s3_cn: 踏勘绿地时，我们看到了那头猪。

cn: n. 销；针；v. 钉住；归责
s1_en: We pinned down the fault to one sensor, not the whole loom.
s1_cn: 我们把故障锁定在一个传感器而非整束线。
s2_en: The locator pin seats the panel so every car is built the same.
s2_cn: 定位销安放板材，使每辆车都造得一致。
s3_en: Pin the owner to the finding so it never bounces between shifts.
s3_cn: 把责任人钉在发现项上，使其从不在班次间踢皮球。

s1_en: The exhaust pipe design was optimized for lower emissions.
s1_cn: 排气管设计经过优化以降低排放。
s2_en: Please check the hydraulic pipe for leaks.
s2_cn: 请检查液压管是否有泄漏。
s3_en: The supplier delivered the pipe samples for testing.
s3_cn: 供应商交付了管材样品用于测试。

s1_en: The cargo plane carried urgent parts to the overseas plant.
s1_cn: 货运飞机把紧急零部件运往海外工厂。
s2_en: A test plane validated the new engine at high altitude.
s2_cn: 一架试验飞机在高原验证了新发动机。
s3_en: We booked a plane to the auto show for the launch team.
s3_cn: 我们为发布团队订了飞往车展的航班。

s1_en: The name plate shows the VIN and build date of the unit.
s1_cn: 铭牌标示着该车的车架号与生产日期。
s2_en: A cracked plate in the canteen was pulled from service.
s2_cn: 食堂里一只开裂的盘子被撤下停用。
s3_en: We stamped the model plate before the body left the cell.
s3_cn: 车身下线前，我们压印了车型铭牌。

cn: n. 犁；v. 犁；投入（资金/精力）
s1_en: We ploughed the savings back into a second inspection station.
s1_cn: 我们把省下的钱再投入，建了第二个检验工位。
s2_en: The test track ploughs through mud to prove the seal holds.
s2_cn: 测试道犁过泥泞，以验证密封有效。
s3_en: Profit was ploughed back into training, not just paid out as bonus.
s3_cn: 利润被再投入培训，而非只当作奖金发掉。

cn: n. 口袋，衣袋，储物袋；v. 把…装入口袋；赚取，留存（收益）
phrase_cn: 把节省下来的钱装进口袋（留存收益）
s1_en: We pocket the savings from the energy retrofit each quarter.
s1_cn: 每个季度，我们都把节能改造省下的钱留存入账。
s2_en: The inspector found a bolt in the door pocket during audit.
s2_cn: 审计时，检验员在门板储物袋里发现了一颗螺栓。
s3_en: He kept the spare key in his coat pocket on the shop floor.
s3_cn: 他在车间把备用钥匙放在外套口袋里。

meanings.cn: 把…装入口袋；赚取，留存（收益）

s1_en: The melting pot is used for aluminum alloy preparation in the foundry.
s1_cn: 熔炼锅用于铸造车间的铝合金制备。
s2_en: We monitor the pot temperature to ensure proper material properties.
s2_cn: 我们监控锅温以确保正确的材料性能。
s3_en: The pot is cleaned and inspected after each production batch.
s3_cn: 锅在每个生产批次后清洗和检查。

s1_en: The liability claim became a hot potato no department wanted.
s1_cn: 那起责任索赔成了没人想接的烫手山芋。
s2_en: Compared with the merger, the rebrand is small potatoes.
s2_cn: 与合并相比，品牌重塑只是小事一桩。
s3_en: The CFO deferred the hot potato to a dedicated task force.
s3_cn: 首席财务官把这个棘手问题交给了专项小组处理。

cn: n. 监狱；n. 禁锢；困局
s1_en: The old process was a prison of rework, so we rebuilt it around one-pass.
s1_cn: 旧工艺是返工的困局，因此我们围绕一次合格重建了它。
s2_en: The audit found no fraud, only a control gap, not a prison term.
s2_cn: 审计没发现欺诈，只有控制漏洞，不涉及刑责。
s3_en: We broke the prison of silo thinking by putting sales and plant in one room.
s3_cn: 我们把销售与工厂放进一个房间，打破了竖井思维的困局。

s1_en: The hydraulic pump is tested for pressure and flow rate before installation.
s1_cn: 液压泵在安装前进行压力和流量测试。
s2_en: We monitor pump performance through the predictive maintenance system.
s2_cn: 我们通过预测性维护系统监控泵的性能。
s3_en: A pump failure triggers an automatic shutdown of the hydraulic circuit.
s3_cn: 泵故障触发液压回路的自动关闭。

s1_en: The train runs on the rail.
s1_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
s2_en: Hold the rail when you go down the stairs.
s2_cn: 下楼时请扶住栏杆。
s3_en: The worker fixed the broken rail.
s3_cn: 工人修好了坏掉的铁轨。

s1_en: A rat in the warehouse forced a pest-control sweep.
s1_cn: 仓库里的老鼠促使进行了一次虫害排查。
s2_en: The old rat chewed through a cable on the line.
s2_cn: 那只老老鼠咬断了产线上的一根线缆。
s3_en: We set traps after spotting the rat near the canteen.
s3_cn: 在食堂附近发现老鼠后，我们布设了捕鼠器。

s1_en: Keep the receipt to claim the travel expense.
s1_cn: 保留收据才能报销差旅费。
s2_en: The system flagged a receipt without a PO number.
s2_cn: 系统标记了一张没有采购单号的收据。
s3_en: We matched the receipt to the monthly ledger.
s3_cn: 我们把收据与月度台账进行了核对。

cn: n. 环；n. 铃声；v. 环绕；响
s1_en: The name rang a bell, so we checked the old audit and found the pattern.
s1_cn: 这个名字耳熟，于是我们查了旧审计，发现了规律。
s2_en: The robot rings the part with a seal so water never enters the joint.
s2_cn: 机器人给零件绕上一圈密封，使水永不入接缝。
s3_en: The bell rang at the gate to mark the start of the safety stand-down.
s3_cn: 工厂铃声在门口响起，标志安全停工反思开始。

cn: n. 杆；棒；v. 用杆推；强化
s1_en: The connecting rod passed the fatigue test that proves it lasts the life.
s1_cn: 连杆通过了证明其用满寿命的疲劳测试。
s2_en: We rod the part into the fixture so it seats without a manual nudge.
s2_cn: 我们用推杆把零件送进夹具，无需手动扶。
s3_en: A worn rod in the test rig was caught early, before it broke a run.
s3_cn: 台架上磨损的杆被及早发现，没在运行中折断。

s1_en: The roof assembly was optimized for faster production.
s1_cn: 屋顶装配经过优化以加快生产。
s2_en: Please verify the roof before the vehicle leaves the plant.
s2_cn: 车辆出厂前请验证屋顶。
s3_en: The roof was redesigned for improved safety performance.
s3_cn: 屋顶经过重新设计以提升安全性能。

cn: n. 根；根源；v. 扎根；根除
s1_en: We rooted out the cause in the weld, not the paint, where it showed.
s1_cn: 我们查清了根因在焊接而非表面显现的涂装。
s2_en: The training took root when the line started closing its own findings.
s2_cn: 当产线开始自己关闭发现项时，培训就扎下了根。
s3_en: Root out a defect at the source and it never returns downstream.
s3_cn: 在源头根除缺陷，它就不会在下游重现。

cn: n. 帆；船帆；v. 航行；启航
s1_en: The cargo ship set sail with the urgent parts.
s1_cn: 货轮载着紧急零部件启航。
s2_en: A small sail on the prototype boat passed the water test.
s2_cn: 原型船上的小帆通过了涉水测试。
s3_en: We watched the sail disappear beyond the port.
s3_cn: 我们看着那面帆消失在港口尽头。

s1_en: There is a school of thought that favors local assembly.
s1_cn: 有一种思路主张本地组装。
s2_en: He is old school about supplier loyalty.
s2_cn: 他在供应商忠诚度上是老派作风。
s3_en: The crisis was a school of hard knocks for the young team.
s3_cn: 这场危机对年轻团队来说是一堂逆境实战课。

s1_en: The technician cut the cable ties with a pair of scissors.
s1_cn: 技术员用剪刀剪断扎带。
s2_en: She used scissors to trim the excess material from the gasket.
s2_cn: 她用剪刀修掉密封垫上多余的材料。
s3_en: Keep the scissors in the toolbox after you finish.
s3_cn: 用完后把剪刀放回工具箱。

s1_en: The engineer tightened the screw on the bracket with a wrench.
s1_cn: 工程师用扳手拧紧支架上的螺丝。
s2_en: A loose screw made the panel rattle while driving.
s2_cn: 一颗松动的螺丝导致行驶时面板发出异响。
s3_en: We counted the screws before assembling the module.
s3_cn: 我们在装配模块前清点螺丝数量。

s1_en: He planted the seeds in the soil.
s1_cn: 他把种子种进土里。
s2_en: The seed grew into a small tree.
s2_cn: 种子长成了小树。
s3_en: We store the seeds in a dry box.
s3_cn: 我们把种子存放在干燥盒里。

s1_en: A flock of sheep grazed near the green-field site.
s1_cn: 一群羊在绿地旁吃草。
s2_en: The sheep wandered onto the rural test track at dawn.
s2_cn: 黎明时分，羊溜上了乡村试车道。
s3_en: We counted the sheep before the farm handover.
s3_cn: 交接农场前，我们清点了羊的数量。

cn: n. 架；搁板；v. 搁置；下架
s1_en: The old tool sat on the shelf until a clever use found it a second life.
s1_cn: 旧工具一直搁着，直到一个巧思让它重获新生。
s2_en: The spare parts shelf is stocked so a stop never waits on a part.
s2_cn: 备件架备足货，使停线从不等件。
s3_en: We pulled the change off the shelf and ran it the week the line was free.
s3_cn: 我们把这项变更从"搁置"里取出，在产线有空的那周执行了。

s1_en: We ship the parts to the factory by truck.
s1_cn: 我们用卡车把零件运到工厂。
s2_en: The goods were shipped yesterday.
s2_cn: 货物昨天已发出。
s3_en: A big ship carried the cars across the ocean.
s3_cn: 一艘大船把汽车运过了大洋。

cn: n. 衬衫；本金（keep one's shirt 保住老本）
s1_en: The hedge protected the fund and kept its shirt in the crash.
s1_cn: 对冲保护了基金，在崩盘中保住了本钱。
s2_en: Avoid stuffed shirts in the workshop; we need frank input.
s2_cn: 研讨会上别请那些自命不凡的人，我们需要坦诚的意见。
s3_en: He nearly lost his shirt on the unsupported venture.
s3_cn: 他在那个缺乏支撑的项目上，差点血本无归。

meanings.cn: 衬衫；本金（keep one's shirt 保住老本）

cn: n. 鞋；处境（in one's shoes 设身处地）
s1_en: Try to see the contract from the client's shoes before negotiating.
s1_cn: 谈判前，试着站在客户立场看这份合同。
s2_en: She filled the CFO's shoes remarkably well during the transition.
s2_cn: 在交接期，她非常出色地接替了首席财务官的职位。
s3_en: The market is waiting for the other shoe to drop after the price cut.
s3_cn: 降价之后，市场仍在等待后续的连锁反应。

meanings.cn: 鞋；处境（in one's shoes 设身处地）

cn: n. 皮；外壳；v. 覆面；去皮
s1_en: The fix was skin-deep until we changed the tooling that caused it.
s1_cn: 在改掉致因的工装前，整改只是表面的。
s2_en: The door skin is laser-welded so no seam shows on the outer face.
s2_cn: 车门外板采用激光焊，外表面看不到缝。
s3_en: We skin the bumper with a soft layer that resists a light knock.
s3_cn: 我们给保险杠覆一层软质，抗轻微磕碰。

s1_en: The uniform includes a work skirt for the showroom hosts.
s1_cn: 制服包含展厅接待员的职业裙装。
s2_en: She wore a skirt to the dealer conference.
s2_cn: 她穿着裙子参加了经销商大会。
s3_en: A long skirt caught on the step during the plant tour.
s3_cn: 工厂参观时，一条长裙绊到了台阶。

s1_en: A snake near the track delayed the outdoor test.
s1_cn: 跑道旁的蛇推迟了户外测试。
s2_en: The snake slithered under the storage container.
s2_cn: 蛇溜到了仓储集装箱下面。
s3_en: We posted a snake warning after the sighting.
s3_cn: 发现蛇后，我们张贴了警示。

cn: n. 袜子；v. 储存（sock away）；振作（pull up one's socks）
s1_en: The company socked away cash during the boom to survive the downturn.
s1_cn: 公司在繁荣期储备现金，以熬过下行期。
s2_en: After the failed launch, the team pulled up its socks and rebuilt the plan.
s2_cn: 发布失利后，团队振作精神，重新制定了计划。
s3_en: We socked away a portion of profit for the R&D fund.
s3_cn: 我们把一部分利润存入了研发基金。

meanings.cn: 储存（sock away）；振作（pull up one's socks）

cn: n. 铲；v. 铲挖；扎实投入
s1_en: We called a spade a spade in the review: the fixture was the fault.
s1_cn: 我们在评审里直言不讳：夹具就是故障源。
s2_en: The team spaded the groundwork so the line could ramp without surprise.
s2_cn: 团队扎实打下了基础，使产线爬坡毫无意外。
s3_en: A spade in the test bay digs the car out of the mud for the next run.
s3_cn: 测试区的铲子把车从泥里挖出，准备下一轮。

cn: n. 海绵；v. 用海绵擦；吸收
s1_en: The acoustic sponge soaks up cabin noise for a quiet ride.
s1_cn: 吸音海绵吸收座舱噪声，换来安静驾乘。
s2_en: We sponged up the spill before it reached the next car on the line.
s2_cn: 我们在液体溅到下一台车前就擦掉了。
s3_en: A good team sponges up know-how from the veteran before he retires.
s3_cn: 好的团队会在老技师退休前，把他的经验吸收过来。

s1_en: He stirred the sample with a spoon before the lab test.
s1_cn: 实验室检测前，他用勺子搅了搅样品。
s2_en: The canteen issued a spoon with every meal tray.
s2_cn: 食堂每份餐盘都配了一把勺子。
s3_en: A plastic spoon snapped in the break room.
s3_cn: 休息室里一把塑料勺折断了。

cn: n. 春天；春季；n. 弹簧；发条
s1_en: The suspension spring was upgraded for better ride comfort.
s1_cn: 悬架弹簧升级以提升乘坐舒适性。
s2_en: We source springs from a specialized supplier.
s2_cn: 我们从专业供应商采购弹簧。
s3_en: The spring fatigue test passed the 200,000-cycle mark.
s3_cn: 弹簧疲劳测试通过了20万次循环。

cn: n. 广场；正方形；adj. 正方形的；平方的
s1_en: The new plant square hosts the annual supplier fair.
s1_cn: 新建的厂区广场举办年度供应商大会。
s2_en: We drew a square on the layout to mark the staging area.
s2_cn: 我们在布置图上画了一个正方形，标出暂存区。
s3_en: The team gathered in the square for the safety drill.
s3_cn: 团队在广场集合进行安全演练。

cn: n. 戳；印章；v. 冲压；盖章
s1_en: The press stamps the bracket in one hit, no cut, no scrap edge.
s1_cn: 压机一次冲压出支架，无切削、无废边。
s2_en: We stamped out the old defect by changing the die, not the inspection.
s2_cn: 我们靠换模而非加检，消除了那个旧缺陷。
s3_en: The audit stamp on the file means the run is cleared to ship.
s3_cn: 文件上的审计章，意味着这批货已获准发运。

s1_en: We saw a bright star in the night sky.
s1_cn: 我们在夜空中看到一颗明亮的星星。
s2_en: The north star shows the direction.
s2_cn: 北极星指示方向。
s3_en: She is a rising star in the team.
s3_cn: 她是团队里的新星。

s1_en: We are building a charging station network in major cities.
s1_cn: 我们正在主要城市建设充电站网络。
s2_en: Each work station on the line has a standard operating procedure.
s2_cn: 线上每个工位都有标准作业指导书。
s3_en: The fuel station partnership covers 500 locations nationwide.
s3_cn: 加油站合作伙伴关系覆盖全国500个站点。

cn: n. 茎；杆；v. 阻止；源于
s1_en: The fault stemmed from a loose torque, so we added a check at the gun.
s1_cn: 故障源于扭矩松动，于是我们在枪上加了检查。
s2_en: A quick fix stemmed the leak before a single car left the plant.
s2_cn: 一次快速修复在任一辆车离厂前就止住了渗漏。
s3_en: The stem of the wiper holds the blade at the right angle to the glass.
s3_cn: 雨刮的杆把刮片保持在相对玻璃的正确角度。

s1_en: We stuck to the frozen spec, which is why the launch hit date.
s1_cn: 我们遵守了冻结的规范，这正是上市准点的原因。
s2_en: The label sticks through the wash and the heat, so it stays traceable.
s2_cn: 标签经得起水洗和高温，因此始终可追溯。
s3_en: A control stick on the rig lets the tester jog the part by hand.
s3_cn: 台架上的控制杆让测试员手动点动零件。

s1_en: The line workers wear compression stockings to ease leg fatigue.
s1_cn: 线操作工穿压力长袜，缓解腿部疲劳。
s2_en: She packed a spare stocking for the trade-show trip.
s2_cn: 她为展会出差打包了一双备用长袜。
s3_en: A torn stocking failed the uniform check.
s3_cn: 一条破长袜没通过着装检查。

cn: n. 胃；腹部；n. 承受力
s1_en: The peak season tested whether the team could stomach the workload.
s1_cn: 旺季考验了团队能否承受工作量。
s2_en: A heavy lunch slows the stomach and the afternoon focus alike.
s2_cn: 丰盛午餐既拖慢胃，也拖慢午后专注力。
s3_en: Ergonomic seating eases stomach strain during long shifts.
s3_cn: 人机座椅减轻长班时的胃部压迫。

cn: n. 商店；连锁店（chain store）；v. 储存；储备
s1_en: Our parts are sold through a national chain store network.
s1_cn: 我们的零部件通过全国连锁店网络销售。
s2_en: Big changes are in store after the restructuring.
s2_cn: 重组之后，重大变化即将到来。
s3_en: The retailer stores value in its loyalty program.
s3_cn: 这家零售商把价值寄托在会员忠诚计划上。

s1_en: The new model hits the street next month after a six-month pre-sell.
s1_cn: 新车型在六个月预售之后，下月正式上市。
s2_en: We test the car on the street, not just the rig, to catch real use.
s2_cn: 我们在真实街道而非仅台架上测试，以捕捉真实使用。
s3_en: Word on the street said the range beat the claim, and the data agreed.
s3_cn: 市面上的说法是续航超过了标称，数据也认同。

cn: n. 太阳；n. 日晒；暴晒
s1_en: We test paint under the sun for a thousand hours to prove it won't fade.
s1_cn: 我们把漆面在阳光下测试一千小时，以证明不褪色。
s2_en: The solar canopy in the lot cuts the plant's power bill under the sun.
s2_cn: 停车场上方的光伏顶棚，在日照下降低了工厂电费。
s3_en: Every fix under the sun was tried before we changed the tooling.
s3_cn: 在换工装前，我们试遍了天下各种修法。

cn: n. 桌子；n. 表格；表；v. 搁置；提交（议案）
s1_en: The reference table lists all approved material specifications.
s1_cn: 参考表列出了所有批准的材料规格。
s2_en: We update the conversion table when new measurement units are adopted.
s2_cn: 采用新计量单位时我们更新换算表。
s3_en: The torque table is posted at each assembly workstation for reference.
s3_cn: 扭矩表张贴在每个装配工位供参考。

cn: n. 尾；n. 尾灯；n. 尾部；末尾
s1_en: The tail light must pass photometric test before homologation.
s1_cn: 尾灯在认证前须通过光度测试。
s2_en: The last batch formed the tail of the shipment queue.
s2_cn: 最后一批成了发运队列的尾部。
s3_en: A loose tail on the harness caused the intermittent fault.
s3_cn: 线束上一处松脱的尾部导致了间歇故障。

cn: n. 线；螺纹；v. 穿行；拧入
s1_en: The wire threads through the loom so it never chafes on a sharp edge.
s1_cn: 线束穿过线槽，使其从不在锐边磨损。
s2_en: The robot threads the bolt into the blind hole without cross-threading.
s2_cn: 机器人把螺栓拧入盲孔，不会滑牙。
s3_en: A red thread of safety runs through every step of the build.
s3_cn: 一条安全红线贯穿制造的每一步。

cn: n. 喉；喉部；n. 型腔喉部（模具）
s1_en: The narrow throat of the mold slowed the fill at the corners.
s1_cn: 模具狭窄的喉部让拐角处充填变慢。
s2_en: The operator wore a throat mic to keep hands free on the line.
s2_cn: 操作员戴喉麦，以在产线上解放双手。
s3_en: A dry throat from dusty air reminds us to wear the mask.
s3_cn: 粉尘空气导致的咽干，提醒我们戴口罩。

cn: n. 拇指；n. 优盘（thumb drive）；n. 点赞（thumbs up）
s1_en: The pilot run got a thumbs up from the quality board.
s1_cn: 试生产获得了质量委员会的认可。
s2_en: Save the config to a thumb drive before the system patch.
s2_cn: 系统打补丁前，把配置存到优盘。
s3_en: He gave the supplier a thumbs up after the on-time delivery.
s3_cn: 准时交付后，他给供应商点了赞。

s1_en: Open a service ticket for the faulty unit.
s1_cn: 为故障机开一张服务工单。
s2_en: The ticket queue cleared before the shift ended.
s2_cn: 工单队列在班次结束前清空了。
s3_en: We scanned the parking ticket at the gate.
s3_cn: 我们在门口扫了停车票。

cn: n. 脚趾；n. 端部；边缘；v. 用脚触；遵从
s1_en: Every plant toes the line on safety, or the line stops for a stand-down.
s1_cn: 每家工厂都遵守安全规矩，否则停线做安全反思。
s2_en: The toe of the door checks the gap so the panel sits flush with the body.
s2_cn: 车门的端部核对间隙，使板材与车身齐平。
s3_en: He toed the brake to hold the car on the slope during the test.
s3_cn: 他轻点刹车，在测试中把车停在坡上。

s1_en: The trim uses a tongue and groove so the two pieces lock with no gap.
s1_cn: 饰条采用榫卯结构，使两块严丝合缝无间隙。
s2_en: The robot places the tongue into the groove in one smooth pass.
s2_cn: 机器人一次平稳地把榫头嵌入卯眼。
s3_en: A worn tongue let the panel rattle, so we swapped the clip before run.
s3_cn: 磨损的榫头让板材异响，于是我们在开线前换了卡子。

s1_en: She cut her teeth on the new platform development program as a junior engineer.
s1_cn: 她作为初级工程师，在新平台研发项目中积累了最初的实战经验。
s2_en: The negotiator fought tooth and nail to protect the margin.
s2_cn: 这位谈判代表为保住利润空间而竭尽全力。
s3_en: The CFO examined the budget line by line, unwilling to leave a single loose tooth in the numbers.
s3_cn: 首席财务官逐行审查预算，不愿在数据中留下任何松动之处。

s1_en: The plant rebuilt the whole town around the factory.
s1_cn: 工厂围绕厂区重建了整座城镇。
s2_en: We hired most workers from the nearby town.
s2_cn: 我们从附近的城镇聘用了大部分工人。
s3_en: The town council approved the new logistics road.

s2_en: Solid aluminum is used for the battery housing to reduce weight.
s2_cn: 电池外壳使用实心铝以减轻重量。
s3_en: We verify the solid structure integrity in the crash simulation.
s3_cn: 我们在碰撞仿真中验证实心结构完整性。

s1_en: Special tooling is required for the new model body in white.
s1_cn: 新车型白车身需要特殊工装。
s2_en: A special inspection is conducted for safety critical components.
s2_cn: 安全关键零件进行特殊检查。
s3_en: We provide special training for operators on the new equipment.
s3_cn: 我们为新设备操作员提供专门培训。

s1_en: A strange noise from the engine prompted a teardown inspection.
s1_cn: 发动机的异常噪声促成了拆解检查。
s2_en: We investigate strange vibration patterns in the transmission.
s2_cn: 我们调查变速箱中的异常振动模式。
s3_en: Strange measurement readings are flagged for engineering review.
s3_cn: 异常测量读数被标记为工程评审。

s1_cn: 薄壁设计降低了整车重量。
s2_en: Thin sheet metal is used for non-structural body panels.
s2_cn: 非结构件车身面板使用薄钢板。
s3_en: We verify the thin film thickness on all coated parts.
s3_cn: 我们验证所有涂层零件的薄膜厚度。
